segs.text: וַיְדַבֵּר יְיָ אֶל־משֶׁה לֵּאמֹר: צַו אֶת־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם, אֶת־קָרְבָּנִי לַחְמִי לְאִשַּׁי, רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹחִי תִּשְׁמְרוּ לְהַקְרִיב לִי בְּמוֹעֲדוֹ: וְאָמַרְתָּ לָהֶם, זֶה הָאִשֶּׁה אֲשֶׁר תַּקְרִֽיבוּ לַייָ, כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה תְמִימִם, שְׁנַֽיִם לַיּוֹם, עֹלָה תָמִיד: אֶת־הַכֶּֽבֶשׂ אֶחָד תַּעֲשֶׂה בַבֹּֽקֶר, וְאֵת הַכֶּֽבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם: וַֽעֲשִׂירִית הָאֵיפָה סֹֽלֶת לְמִנְחָה, בְּלוּלָה בְּשֶֽׁמֶן כָּתִית רְבִיעִת הַהִין: עֹלַת תָּמִיד, הָעֲשֻׂיָה בְּהַר סִינַי לְרֵֽיחַ נִיחֹֽחַ אִשֶּׁה לַייָ: וְנִסְכּוֹ רְבִיעִת הַהִין לַכֶּֽבֶשׂ הָאֶחָד, בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ הַסֵּךְ נֶֽסֶךְ שֵׁכָר לַייָ: וְאֵת הַכֶּֽבֶשׂ הַשֵּׁנִי תַּעֲשֶׂה בֵּין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם, כְּמִנְחַת הַבֹּֽקֶר וּכְנִסְכּוֹ תַּעֲשֶׂה, אִשֵּׁה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹֽחַ לַייָ:
וְשָׁחַֽט אֹתֽוֹ עַל יֶֽרֶךְ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ צָפֹֽנָה לִפְנֵֽי יְיָ, וְזָרְקֽוּ בְּנֵי אַהֲרֹֽן הַכֹּהֲנִֽים אֶת־דָּמֽוֹ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ סָבִֽיב:

אַתָּה־הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, שֶׁהִקְטִירוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת־קְטֹרֶת הַסַּמִּים, בִּזְמַן שֶׁבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ קַיָּם, כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָ אוֹתָם עַל־יַד מֹשֶׁה נְבִיאֶךָ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ:

וַיֹּֽאמֶר יְיָ אֶל־משֶׁה, קַח־לְךָ סַמִּים, נָטָף וּשְׁחֵֽלֶת, וְחֶלְבְּנָה, סַמִּים, וּלְבֹנָה זַכָּה, בַּד בְּבַד יִהְיֶה: וְעָשִֽׂיתָ אֹתָהּ קְטֹֽרֶת, רֹֽקַח מַעֲשֵׂה רוֹקֵֽחַ, מְמֻלָּח טָהוֹר קֹֽדֶשׁ: וְשָׁחַקְתָּ מִמֶּֽנָּה הָדֵק, וְנָתַתָּה מִמֶּֽנָּה לִפְנֵי הָעֵדֻת בְּאֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵד, אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לְךָ שָֽׁמָּה, קֹֽדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם: וְנֶאֱמַר, וְהִקְטִיר עָלָיו אַהֲרֹן קְטֹֽרֶת סַמִּים, בַּבֹּֽקֶר בַּבֹּֽקֶר בְּהֵיטִיבוֹ אֶת־הַנֵּרֹת יַקְטִירֶֽנָּה: וּבְהַעֲלֹת אַהֲרֹן אֶת־הַנֵּרֹת בֵּין הָֽעַרְבַּֽיִם יַקְטִירֶֽנָּה, קְטֹֽרֶת תָּמִיד לִפְנֵי יְיָ לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם:

parts.text: פִּטּוּם הַקְּטֹֽרֶת כֵּיצַד: שְׁלֹש מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים וּשְׁמוֹנָה מָנִים הָיוּ בָהּ. שְׁלֹש מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁה כְּמִנְיַן יְמוֹת הַחַמָּה,
שֶׁמֵּהֶם מַכְנִיס כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל מְלֹא חָפְנָיו בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים,
וְשׁוֹחֲקָן יָפָה יָפָה כְּדֵי שֶׁתְּהֵא דַקָּה מִן הַדַּקָּה. וְאַחַד עָשָׂר סַמְּמָנִין הָֽיוּ בָהּ. וְאֵֽלּוּ־הֵן:
וְכַרְכֹּם מִשְׁקַל שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר מָנֶה,
קִנָּמוֹן תִּשְׁעָה. בֹּרִית כַּרְשִׁינָה תִּשְׁעָה קַבִּין,
יֵין קַפְרִיסִין סְאִין תְּלָתָא וְקַבִּין תְּלָתָא,
וְאִם אֵין לוֹ יֵין קַפְרִיסִין מֵבִיא חֲמַר חִוַּרְיָן עַתִּיק. מֶֽלַח סְדוֹמִית רֹֽבַע,
כָּל־שֶׁהוּא. רַבִּי נָתָן הַבַּבְלִי אוֹמֵר: אַף כִּפַּת הַיַּרְדֵּן כָּל־שֶׁהִיא,
וְאִם חִסַּר אֶחָד מִכָּל־סַמְּמָנֶֽיהָ חַיָּב מִיתָה:

segs.text: רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר: הַצֳּרִי אֵינוֹ אֶלָּא שְׂרָף הַנּוֹטֵף מֵעֲצֵי הַקְּטָף, בֹּרִית כַּרְשִׁינָה שֶׁשָׁפִין בָּה אֶת־הַצִפֹּרֶן, כִּדֵי שֶׁתְּהֵא נָאָה. יֵין קַפְרִיסִין שֶׁשׁוֹרִין בּוֹ אֶת־הַצִפֹּרֶן, כְּדֵי שֶׁתְּהֵא עַזָּה. וַהֲלֹא מֵי רַגְלַֽיִם יָפִין לָהּ, אֶלָּא שֶׁאֵין מַכְנִיסִין מֵי רַגְלַֽיִם בַּמִּקְדָּשׁ מִפְּנֵי הַכָּבוֹד:

תַּנְיָא רַבִּי נָתָן אוֹמֵר: כְּשֶׁהוּא שׁוֹחֵק אוֹמֵר: הָדֵק הֵיטֵב, הֵיטֵב הָדֵק, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהַקּוֹל יָפֶה לַבְּשָׂמִים. פִּטְּמָהּ לַחֲצָאִין כְּשֵׁרָה, לִשְׁלִישׁ וְלִרְבִֽיעַ, לֹא שָׁמַֽעְנוּ: אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה זֶה הַכְּלָל, אִם כְּמִדָּתָהּ כְּשֵׁרָה לַחֲצָאִין. וְאִם חִסַּר אֶחָד מִכָּל־סַמְּמָנֶֽיהָ חַיָּב מִיתָה:

תַּנְיָא בַּר קַפָּרָא אוֹמֵר: אַחַת לְשִׁשִּׁים אוֹ לְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה הָיְתָה בָאָה שֶׁל שִׁירַֽיִם לַחֲצָאִין: וְעוֹד תָּנֵי בַּר קַפָּרָא, אִלּוּ הָיָה נוֹתֵן בָּהּ קוֹרְטוֹב שֶׁל דְּבַשׁ, אֵין אָדָם יָכוֹל לַעֲמֹד מִפְּנֵי רֵיחָהּ, וְלָֽמָּה אֵין מְעָרְבִין בָּהּ דְּבַשׁ, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהַתּוֹרָה אָמְרָה, כִּי כָל־שְׂאֹר וְכָל־דְּבַשׁ לֹא־תַקְטִֽירוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ אִשֶּׁה לַייָ:

Hashem spoke to Moses, saying: Command the children of Israel and say to them: My offering, My food for My fire-offerings, My pleasing aroma, you shall take care to bring to Me at its appointed time. And you shall say to them: This is the fire-offering that you shall bring to Hashem: two unblemished lambs in their first year each day, as a continual burnt-offering. One lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the second lamb you shall offer at twilight; and a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a meal-offering, mixed with a quarter of a hin of beaten oil. It is a continual burnt-offering, which was made at Mount Sinai as a pleasing aroma, a fire-offering to Hashem. Its libation shall be a quarter of a hin for the one lamb; in the holy place you shall pour out the libation of strong drink to Hashem. And the second lamb you shall offer at twilight; like the morning meal-offering and its libation you shall offer it, a fire-offering of pleasing aroma to Hashem.
He shall slaughter it on the north side of the altar before Hashem, and the sons of Aaron, the kohanim, shall sprinkle its blood upon the altar all around.

You are Hashem our God and God of our fathers, before Whom our fathers burned the incense of spices, at the time when the Temple stood, as You commanded them through Moses Your prophet, as it is written in Your Torah:

Hashem said to Moses: Take for yourself spices: balsam, onycha and galbanum, spices, and pure frankincense; there shall be equal parts of each. You shall make it into incense, a compound of the perfumer’s art, salted, pure and holy. You shall grind some of it very fine, and place some of it before the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you; it shall be most holy to you. And it is said: “Aaron shall burn upon it incense of spices; every morning when he tends the lamps he shall burn it. And when Aaron lights the lamps at twilight he shall burn it, a perpetual incense before Hashem throughout your generations.”

The Sages taught: How was the incense compounded? It weighed three hundred and sixty-eight maneh in all: three hundred and sixty-five, corresponding to the days of the solar year, a maneh for each day, half a maneh in the morning and half a maneh in the afternoon; and three extra manehs, from which the High Priest would take two handfuls into the Holy of Holies on Yom Kippur. He would return them to the mortar on the eve of Yom Kippur, and grind them very, very fine, so that they would be the finest of the fine. It contained eleven spices, and these are they: (1) balsam, (2) onycha, (3) galbanum, (4) and frankincense, seventy maneh each; (5) myrrh, (6) cassia, (7) spikenard, (8) and saffron, sixteen maneh each; (9) costus, twelve; (10) aromatic bark, three; (11) cinnamon, nine. Lye of Carshina, nine kab; Cyprus wine, three se’ah and three kab; and if he does not have Cyprus wine, he brings strong old white wine. Sodom salt, a quarter-kab; a minute amount of a smoke-raising herb. Rabbi Natan the Babylonian says: also a minute amount of Jordan amber. If one put honey into it, he spoiled it; and if he left out any one of its ingredients, he is liable to death.

Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: The balsam is nothing other than resin that drips from the balsam trees. Lye of Carshina is used to rub the onycha, to make it beautiful. Cyprus wine is used to soak the onycha, to make it pungent. Although urine would be suitable for this, urine is not brought into the Temple out of respect.

It was taught: Rabbi Natan says: As he would grind, he would say, “Grind well, well grind,” because the sound is good for the spices. If he compounded it in half quantities, it is valid; in a third or a quarter, we have not heard. Rabbi Yehudah said: This is the rule: if it was in its proper proportions, it is valid in half quantities; but if he left out any one of its ingredients, he is liable to death.

It was taught: Bar Kappara says: Once in sixty or seventy years, the surplus of the remainders would amount to half. And Bar Kappara further taught: Had one put in a kortov of honey, no person could stand the fragrance of it. And why is honey not mixed into it? Because the Torah said: “For you shall not burn any leaven or any honey as a fire-offering to Hashem.”

Hashem of hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our stronghold, Selah (three times). Hashem of hosts, happy is the person who trusts in You (three times). Hashem, save! May the King answer us on the day we call (three times). Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to Hashem, as in days of old and as in former years.

We beseech You, by the great power of Your right hand, untie the bound. Accept the song of Your people; raise us up, purify us, Awesome One. Mighty One, we beseech You, guard like the pupil of the eye those who seek Your Oneness. Bless them, purify them, grant them always Your righteous compassion. Powerful and Holy One, in Your abundant goodness lead Your congregation. Only and Exalted One, turn to Your people who remember Your holiness. Accept our cry and hear our plea, You Who know hidden things. Blessed be the name of His glorious kingdom forever and ever.

אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶֽךָ עוֹד יְהַלְלֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּֽכָה לּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיְיָ אֱלֹהָיו: תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּֽלֶךְ וַאֲבָרְכָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: בְּכָל־יוֹם אֲבָרְכֶֽךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: גָּדוֹל יְיָ וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד וְלִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵֽקֶר: דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּגְבוּרֹתֶֽיךָ יַגִּֽידוּ: הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶֽךָ וְדִבְרֵי נִפְלְאֹתֶֽיךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה: וֶעֱזוּז נוֹרְאֹתֶֽיךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וּגְדֻלָּתְךָ אֲסַפְּרֶֽנָּה: זֶֽכֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ יַבִּֽיעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ: חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְיָ אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּֽיִם וּגְדָל־חָֽסֶד: טוֹב־יְיָ לַכֹּל וְרַחֲמָיו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו: יוֹדֽוּךָ יְיָ כָּל־מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ וַחֲסִידֶֽיךָ יְבָרְכֽוּכָה: כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ: לְהוֹדִֽיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו וּכְבוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתוֹ: מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל־עֹלָמִים וּמֶמְשַׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדֹר: סוֹמֵךְ יְיָ לְכָל־הַנֹּפְלִים וְזוֹקֵף לְכָל־הַכְּפוּפִים: עֵינֵי־כֹל אֵלֶֽיךָ יְשַׂבֵּֽרוּ וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן־לָהֶם אֶת־אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ: פּוֹתֵֽחַ אֶת־יָדֶֽךָ וּמַשְׂבִּֽיעַ לְכָל־חַי רָצוֹן: צַדִּיק יְיָ בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו וְחָסִיד בְּכָל־מַעֲשָׂיו: קָרוֹב יְיָ לְכָל־קֹרְאָיו לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻֽהוּ בֶאֱמֶת: רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָיו יַעֲשֶׂה וְאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָם יִשְׁמַע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם: שׁוֹמֵר יְיָ אֶת־כָּל־אֹהֲבָיו וְאֵת כָּל־הָרְשָׁעִים יַשְׁמִיד: תְּהִלַּת יְיָ יְדַבֶּר פִּי וִיבָרֵךְ כָּל־בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם הַלְלוּיָהּ:

segs.gloss: Introduces the Half Kaddish after Ashrei
segs.text: <small>הש״ץ אומר חצי קדיש:</small>

parts.text: בְּעָלְמָֽא דִּי בְרָֽא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִֽיךְ מַלְכוּתֵֽהּ,
בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַֽן קָרִיב וְאִמְרֽוּ אָמֵֽן: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּֽא מְבָרַֽךְ לְעָלַֽם וּלְעָלְמֵֽי עָלְמַיָּֽא. יִתְבָּרֵֽךְ,

segs.text: Happy are those who dwell in Your house; they will praise You forever, Selah. Happy is the people for whom this is so; happy is the people whose God is Hashem. A psalm of praise, of David. I will exalt You, my God the King, and bless Your name forever and ever. Every day I will bless You, and praise Your name forever and ever. Great is Hashem and highly praised, and His greatness is unfathomable. One generation will laud Your works to another, and they will declare Your mighty acts. The splendor of Your glorious majesty and Your wondrous deeds I will recount. They will speak of the might of Your awesome acts, and I will tell of Your greatness. They will pour forth the fame of Your abundant goodness, and will sing joyfully of Your righteousness. Hashem is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and great in kindness. Hashem is good to all, and His mercies are over all His works. All Your works will thank You, Hashem, and Your devout ones will bless You. They will speak of the glory of Your kingdom and talk of Your might, to make known to mankind His mighty acts and the glorious splendor of His kingdom. Your kingdom is a kingdom for all worlds, and Your dominion is throughout every generation. Hashem supports all who fall, and raises up all who are bowed down. The eyes of all look hopefully to You, and You give them their food in its time. You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing. Hashem is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds. Hashem is near to all who call upon Him, to all who call upon Him in truth. He fulfills the desire of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them. Hashem guards all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy. My mouth will speak the praise of Hashem, and all flesh will bless His holy name forever and ever. And we will bless God from now and forever. Halleluyah.

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. Amen. In the world that He created according to His will; and may He establish His kingdom, and cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. Amen. In your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say: Amen. May His great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, uplifted and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. Blessed is He. Amen. Beyond all the blessings and songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say: Amen.

בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵֽי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, אֱלֹהֵֽי אַבְרָהָֽם, אֱלֹהֵֽי יִצְחָֽק, וֵאלֹהֵֽי יַעֲקֹֽב, הָאֵֽל הַגָּדֽוֹל הַגִּבּֽוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָֽא, אֵל עֶלְיֽוֹן, גּוֹמֵֽל חֲסָדִֽים טוֹבִֽים, קוֹנֵֽה הַכֹּֽל, וְזוֹכֵֽר חַסְדֵּֽי אָבֽוֹת, וּמֵבִֽיא גּוֹאֵֽל לִבְנֵֽי בְנֵיהֶֽם לְמַֽעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָֽה:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

segs.text: מֶֽלֶךְ עוֹזֵֽר וּמוֹשִֽׁיעַ וּמָגֵֽן: בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, מָגֵֽן אַבְרָהָֽם:
אַתָּֽה גִּבּֽוֹר לְעוֹלָֽם אֲדֹנָֽי, מְחַיֶּֽה מֵתִֽים אַתָּֽה, רַב לְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ:

parts.en: Causer of the wind to blow, and the rain to fall

segs.text: מְכַלְכֵּֽל חַיִּֽים בְּחֶֽסֶד, מְחַיֶּֽה מֵתִֽים בְּרַחֲמִֽים רַבִּֽים, סוֹמֵֽךְ נוֹפְלִֽים, וְרוֹפֵֽא חוֹלִֽים, וּמַתִּֽיר אֲסוּרִֽים, וּמְקַיֵּֽם אֱמוּנָתֽוֹ לִישֵׁנֵֽי עָפָֽר. מִי־כָמֽוֹךָ בַּֽעַל גְּבוּרֽוֹת וּמִֽי דּֽוֹמֶה לָּךְ, מֶֽלֶךְ מֵמִֽית וּמְחַיֶּֽה וּמַצְמִֽיחַ יְשׁוּעָֽה:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: מִי־כָמֽוֹךָ אָב הָרַחֲמָֽן זוֹכֵֽר יְצוּרָֽיו לְחַיִּֽים בְּרַחֲמִים:

segs.text: וְנֶאֱמָֽן אַתָּֽה לְהַחֲיוֹֽת מֵתִֽים. בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, מְחַיֶּֽה הַמֵּתִֽים:

parts.en: When the chazzan repeats the Amidah, the congregation says this:

parts.text: נַקְדִּישָֽׁךְ וְנַעֲרִיצָֽךְ כְּנֹֽעַם שִֹֽיחַ סוֹד שַֹרְפֵֽי קֹֽדֶשׁ הַמְשַׁלְּשִֽׁים לְךָ קְדֻשָּֽׁה, כַּכָּתֽוּב עַל־יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ, וְקָרָֽא זֶה אֶל־זֶֽה וְאָמַֽר:
קָדֽוֹשׁ ׀ קָדֽוֹשׁ, קָדֽוֹשׁ יְיָ צְבָאֽוֹת, מְלֹא כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ:
יִמְלֹֽךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָֽם, אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹֽן לְדֹר וָדֹֽר, הַלְלוּיָֽהּ:
וּקְדוֹשִֽׁים בְּכָל־יוֹֽם יְהַלְלֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה. בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ,

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

segs.text: אַתָּֽה חוֹנֵֽן לְאָדָֽם דַּֽעַת, וּמְלַמֵּֽד לֶאֱנֽוֹשׁ בִּינָֽה. חָנֵּֽנוּ מֵאִתְּךָֽ חָכְמָֽה בִּינָֽה וָדָֽעַת. בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, חוֹנֵֽן הַדָּֽעַת:
הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ אָבִינוּ לְתוֹרָתֶךָ, וְקָרְבֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ, וְהַחֲזִירֵנוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶיךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הָרוֹצֶה בִּתְשׁוּבָה:
סְלַח־לָנוּ אָבִינוּ, כִּי חָטָאנוּ, מְחוֹל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, כִּי פָשָׁעְנוּ, כִּי אֵל טוֹב וְסַלָּח אָֽתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, חַנּוּן, הַמַּרְבֶּה לִסְלוֹחַ:
רְאֵה נָא בְעָנְיֵנוּ וְרִיבָה רִיבֵנוּ, וּגְאָלֵנוּ מְהֵרָה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, כִּי אֵל גּוֹאֵל חָזָק אָֽתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, גּוֹאֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל:

parts.en: On a public fast day, the chazzan says here Aneinu:
parts.gloss: Aneinu is said in the repetition on fast days

parts.text: עֲנֵֽנוּ יְיָ עֲנֵֽנוּ בְּיוֹם צוֹם תַּעֲנִיתֵֽנוּ, כִּי בְצָרָה גְדוֹלָה אֲנָֽחְנוּ אַל־תֵּֽפֶן אֶל־רִשְׁעֵֽנוּ, וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶֽיךָ מִמֶּֽנּוּ, וְאַל־תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתֵֽנוּ, הֱיֵה נָא קָרוֹב לְשַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ, יְהִי נָא חַסְדְּךָ לְנַחֲמֵֽנוּ, טֶֽרֶם נִקְרָא אֵלֶֽיךָ עֲנֵֽנוּ, כַּדָּבָר שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וְהָיָה טֶֽרֶם יִקְרָֽאוּ וַאֲנִי אֶעֱנֶה, עוֹד הֵם מְדַבְּרִים וַאֲנִי אֶשְׁמָע: כִּי אַתָּה יְיָ הָעוֹנֶה בְּעֵת צָרָה, פּוֹדֶה וּמַצִּיל בְּכָל־עֵת צָרָה וְצוּקָה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הָעוֹנֶה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְֹרָאֵל בְּעֵת צָרָה:

segs.text: רְפָאֵנוּ יְיָ וְנֵרָפֵא, הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה, כִּי תְהִלָּתֵנוּ אָֽתָּה, וְהַעֲלֵה אֲרוּכָה וּרְפוּאָה שְׁלֵמָה לְכָל־מַכּוֹתֵינוּ. כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ רוֹפֵא נֶאֱמָן וְרַחֲמָן אָֽתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, רוֹפֵא חוֹלֵי עַמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:

parts.text: בָּרֵךְ עָלֵינוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת־הַשָּׁנָה הַזֹּאת וְאֵת כָּל־מִינֵי תְבוּאָתָהּ לְטוֹבָה וְתֵן
טַל וּמָטָר לִבְרָכָה עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה,
כִּי אֵל טוֹב וּמֵטִיב אַתָּה וּמְבָרֵךְ הַשָּׁנִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ,

segs.text: תְּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל לְחֵרוּתֵנוּ, וְשָׂא נֵס לְקַבֵּץ גָּלֻיּוֹתֵינוּ, וְקַבְּצֵנוּ יַחַד מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ לְאַרְצֵנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְקַבֵּץ נִדְחֵי עַמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:

parts.text: וּמְלוֹךְ עָלֵינוּ אַתָּה יְיָ לְבַדְּךָ בְּחֶסֶד וּבְרַחֲמִים,

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

segs.text: וְלַמַּלְשִׁינִים אַל תְּהִי תִקְוָה, וְכָל־הַמִּינִים וְכָל־הַזֵּדִים כְּרֶגַע יֹאבֵדוּ, וְכָל אֹיְבֵי עַמְּךָ מְהֵרָה יִכָּרֵתוּ, וּמַּלְכוּת הָרִשְׁעָה מְהֵרָה תְעַקֵּר וּתְשַׁבֵּר וּתְמַגֵּר, וְתַכְנִיעַ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, שֹׁבֵר אֹיְבִים וּמַכְנִיעַ זֵדִים:

עַל־הַצַּדִּיקִים וְעַל־הַחֲסִידִים, וְעַל־זִקְנֵי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל פְּלֵיטַת בֵּית סוֹפְרֵיהֶם, וְעַל־גֵּרֵי הַצֶּדֶק וְעָלֵינוּ, יֶהֱמוּ נָא רַחֲמֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וְתֵן שָׂכָר טוֹב לְכָל־הַבּוֹטְחִים בְּשִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, וְשִׂים חֶלְקֵנוּ עִמָּהֶם, וּלְעוֹלָם לֹא נֵבוֹשׁ כִּי בְךָ בָּטָחְנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מִשְׁעָן וּמִבְטָח לַצַּדִּיקִים:

parts.text: וְכִסֵּֽא דָוִֽד עַבְדְּךָֽ מְהֵרָֽה בְּתוֹכָֽהּ תָּכִֽין,
וּבְנֵֽה אוֹתָֽהּ בְּקָרֽוֹב בְּיָמֵֽינוּ בִּנְיַֽן עוֹלָֽם.

parts.en: On Tisha B'Av, say Nachem here:
Comfort us, Hashem our G-d, those who mourn for Zion and those who mourn for Jerusalem...
parts.text: נַחֵם יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, אֶת־אֲבֵלֵי צִיּוֹן, וְאֶת־אֲבֵלֵי יְרוּשָׁלָֽיִם. וְאֶת־הָעִיר הָאֲבֵלָה וְהַחֲרֵבָה, וְהַבְּזוּיָה וְהַשּׁוֹמֵמָה. הָאֲבֵלָה מִבְּלִי בָנֶֽיהָ, וְהַחֲרֵבָה מִמְּעוֹנוֹתֶֽיהָ, וְהַבְּזוּיָה מִכְּבוֹדָהּ, וְהַשוֹמֵמָה מֵאֵין יוֹשֵׁב. וְהִיא יוֹשֶֽׁבֶת וְרֹאשָׁהּ חָפוּי, כְּאִשָּׁה עֲקָרָה שֶׁלֹּא יָלָֽדָה. וַיְבַלְּעֽוּהָ לִיגְיוֹנוֹת, וְיִירָשֽׁוּהָ עוֹבְדֵי זָרִים, וַיָטִּֽילוֹ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל לֶחָֽרֶב, וַיַּהַרְגוּ בְזָדוֹן חֲסִידֵי עֶלְיוֹן. עַל־כֵּן צִיּוֹן בְּמַר תִּבְכֶּה, וִירוּשָׁלַֽיִם תִּתֵּן קוֹלָהּ, לִבִּי לִבִּי, עַל חַלְלֵיהֶם. מֵעַי מֵעַי, עַל חַלְלֵיהֶם. כִּי אַתָּה יְיָ בָּאֵשׁ הִצַּתָּהּ, וּבָאֵשׁ אַתָּה עָתִיד לִבְנוֹתָהּ. כָּאָמוּר: וַאֲנִי אֶהְיֶה־לָהּ נְאֻם־יְיָ חוֹמַת אֵשׁ סָבִיב, וּלְכָבוֹד אֶהְיֶה בְּתוֹכָהּ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְנַחֵם צִיּוֹן וּבוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלָֽיִם:

segs.text: אֶת־צֶֽמַח דָּוִֽד עַבְדְּךָֽ מְהֵרָֽה תַצְמִֽיחַ, וְקַרְנֽוֹ תָּרֽוּם בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ, כִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָֽ קִּוִּֽינוּ כָּל־הַיּוֹֽם. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מַצְמִֽיחַ קֶֽרֶן יְשׁוּעָֽה:

שְׁמַע קוֹלֵֽנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, אָב הָרַחֲמָֽן רַחֵֽם עָלֵינוּ, וְקַבֵּֽל בְּרַחֲמִֽים וּבְרָצֽוֹן אֶת־תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ, כִּי אֵל שׁוֹמֵֽע תְּפִלּֽוֹת וְתַחֲנוּנִֽים אָֽתָּה, וּמִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ רֵיקָֽם אַל־תְּשִׁיבֵֽנוּ.

parts.en: On a public fast day, say here Aneinu:

parts.text: עֲנֵֽנוּ יְיָ עֲנֵֽנוּ בְּיוֹם צוֹם תַּעֲנִיתֵֽנוּ, כִּי בְצָרָה גְדוֹלָה אֲנָֽחְנוּ אַל־תֵּֽפֶן אֶל־רִשְׁעֵֽנוּ, וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶֽיךָ מִמֶּֽנּוּ, וְאַל־תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּחִנָּתֵֽנוּ, הֱיֵה נָא קָרוֹב לְשַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ, יְהִי נָא חַסְדְּךָ לְנַחֲמֵֽנוּ, טֶֽרֶם נִקְרָא אֵלֶֽיךָ עֲנֵֽנוּ, כַּדָּבָר שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וְהָיָה טֶֽרֶם יִקְרָֽאוּ וַאֲנִי אֶעֱנֶה, עוֹד הֵם מְדַבְּרִים וַאֲנִי אֶשְׁמָע: כִּי אַתָּה יְיָ הָעוֹנֶה בְּעֵת צָרָה, פּוֹדֶה וּמַצִּיל בְּכָל־עֵת צָרָה וְצוּקָה:

segs.text: כִּי אַתָּֽה שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלַּֽת כָּל־פֶּֽה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלָּֽה:

רְצֵה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּעַמְּךָֽ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלִתְפִלָּתָֽם שְׁעֵה, וְהָשֵֽׁב הָעֲבוֹדָֽה לִדְבִֽיר בֵּיתֶךָ, וְאִשֵּֽׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָֽם בְּאַהֲבָֽה תְקַבֵּֽל בְּרָצֽוֹן, וּתְהִֽי לְרָצֽוֹן תָּמִֽיד עֲבוֹדַֽת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ:

parts.en: On Rosh Chodesh and Chol HaMoed, say:

parts.text: וְזִכְרוֹן כָּל־עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְֹרָאֵל לְפָנֶיךָ לִפְלֵיטָה לְטוֹבָה,
לְחֵן וּלְחֶסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים וּלְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם,

זָכְרֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בּוֹ לְטוֹבָה. וּפָקְדֵנוּ בוֹ לִבְרָכָה. וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ בוֹ לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים. וּבִדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים חוּס וְחָנֵּנוּ וְרַחֵם עָלֵינו וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ כִּי אֵלֶיךָ עֵינֵינוּ,
כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה:

segs.text: וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן:

parts.text: לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵֽי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, צוּר חַיֵּינוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ, אַתָּה־הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר, נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ, עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ, וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ, וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־יוֹם עִמָּנוּ, וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־עֵת, עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֱרָיִם. הַטּוֹב, כִּי לֹּא־כָלֽוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, הַמְרַחֵֽם, כִּי לֹא־תַֽמּוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ, כִּי מֵעוֹלָֽם קִוִּֽינוּ לָךְ:

segs.text:
מודים דרבנן
מוֹדִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, אֱלֹהֵי כָּל־בָּשָׂר, יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ, יוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית, בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ, עַל שֶׁהֶחֱיִיתָֽנוּ וְקִיַּמְתָּֽנוּ, כֵּן תְּחַיֵּֽינוּ וּתְקַיְּמֵֽנוּ, וְתֶאֱסוֹף גָּלֻיּוֹתֵֽינוּ לְחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ, וְנָשׁוּב אֵלֶיךָ לִשְׁמוֹר חֻקֶּֽיךָ, וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶֽךָ, וּלְעָבְדְּךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם, עַל שֶׁאָֽנוּ מוֹדִים לָךְ, בָּרוּךְ אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת:

parts.en: On Chanukah and Purim, say here Al HaNissim:

parts.text: וְעַל הַנִּסִּים וְעַל הַפֻּרְקָן וְעַל הַגְּבוּרוֹת וְעַל הַתְּשׁוּעוֹת וְעַל הַנִּפְלָאוֹת שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם בִּזְּמַן הַזֶּה:
בִּימֵי מַתִּתְיָהו בֶּן יוֹחָנָן כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל,
כְּשֶׁעָמְדָה מַלְכוּת יָוָן הָרְשָׁעָה עַל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל,
עָמַדְתָּ לָהֶם בְּעֵת צָרָתָם. רַבְתָּ אֶת־רִיבָם,
וְזֵדִים בְּיַד עוֹסְקֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ. וּלְךָ עָשִׂיתָ שֵׁם גָּדוֹל וְקָדוֹשׁ בְּעוֹלָמֶךָ,
וּלְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשִׂיתָ תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וּפֻרְקָן כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה. וְאַחַר כָּךְ בָּאוּ בָנֶיךָ לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶךָ,
וּשְׁלָלָם לָבוֹז. וְאַתָּה בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים הֵפַרְתָּ אֶת עֲצָתוֹ,

segs.text: וְעַל־כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרֵךְ וְיִתְרוֹמָם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

segs.text: וְכָל־הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל לְעוֹלָם כִּי טוֹב, הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה, הָאֵל הַטּוֹב. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת:

parts.en: On a public fast day, the chazzan says:

parts.text: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם, טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה, חַיִּים חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים, עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ. בָּרְכֵנוּ אָבִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ, כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ נָתַתָּ לָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד, וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם, וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עֵת וּבְכָל־שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: וּבְסֵֽפֶר חַיִּים בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם וּפַרְנָסָה טוֹבָה יְשׁוּעָה וְנֶחָמָה וּגְזֵרוֹת טוֹבוֹת נִזָּכֵר וְנִכָּתֵב לְפָנֶֽיךָ,
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם:

segs.text: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:

אֱלֹהַי, נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע, וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה, וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם, וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה. פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ תִּרְדּוֹף נַפְשִׁי, וְכָל־הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה, מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם: יִהְיוּ כְּמֹץ לִפְנֵי רוּחַ וּמַלְאַךְ יְיָ דּוֹחֶה. לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ, הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי: עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יְמִינֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תּוֹרָתֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ. יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:

segs.en: Bow, take three steps back as if taking leave of the Divine Presence, then bow left, right and center, while saying:
segs.text: <small>כורע ופוסע שלוש פסיעות לאחור, ואחר כך משתחווה שמאלה, ימינה ואמצע, ואומר:</small>

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל,

segs.text: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, שֶׁיִבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ, וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ:
Hashem, open my lips (literally: limits) so that my mouth can declare your praise.

Blessed are you, Hashem, our G-d and G-d of our ancestors; G-d of Avraham, G-d of Yitzchak, G-d of Ya'akov; G-d who is Great, and Mighty, and Above all, Exalted G-d; Who works great kindness, has acquired (literally: purchased) all things, and Who remembers the kindness of our ancestors, Who brings a Deliverer to the children of their children, for the sake of G-d name, in love.
During Ten Days of Repentance: Remember us for kindness, King who desires kindness, write us in the Book of Kindness, for Your own sake, G-d of life.
King, Helper, Saviour, and Shield. Blessed are You. Hashem, Shield of Avraham.
You are Mighty forever, L-rd, You revive the dead, great in salvation.

(From Musaf of the first day of Pesach through the Shacharit of the first day of Shmeini Atzeret) Bringer of the dew. (from Mussaf of the first day of Shmeini Atzeret until- not including- Shacharit of the first day of Pesach): Causer of the wind to blow, and the rain to fall.

Who sustains life with kindness, who revives the dead with great mercy, Who Supports the fallen, Who heals the sick, Who releases the bound, and Who keeps faith with those asleep in the dust. Who is like You, Lord of mighty deeds, who can be compared to You? (You are the) King who brings death and brings life, and Causes salvation to sprout.
During Ten Days of Repentance: Who is like You, Merciful Father, remember us with compassion for a life of kindness.
You are faithful to revive the dead. Blessed are you Hashem, who revives the dead.

We will sanctify You and revere You, in the pleasant manner of the intimate assembly of the holy seraphim who three times declare holiness to You, as it is written by Your prophet: And one called to the other and said: Holy, holy, holy is Hashem of Hosts; the whole earth is full of His glory. Facing them, they offer praise and say: Blessed is the glory of Hashem from His place. And in Your holy words it is written: Hashem shall reign forever, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.

parts.text: You are holy and Your Name is holy, and holy ones praise You every day, Selah. Blessed are You, Hashem,

segs.text: You graciously grant knowledge to man and teach understanding to mortals. Graciously grant us from You knowledge, understanding and insight. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who graciously grants knowledge.
Return us, our Father, to Your Torah, draw us near, our King, to Your service, and bring us back in complete repentance before You. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who desires repentance.
Forgive us, our Father, for we have sinned; pardon us, our King, for we have transgressed; for You are a good and forgiving God. Blessed are You, Hashem, the gracious One Who forgives abundantly.
Look upon our affliction and wage our battle, and redeem us speedily for the sake of Your Name, for You are a powerful Redeemer. Blessed are You, Hashem, Redeemer of Israel.

Answer us, Hashem, answer us on this day of our fast, for we are in great distress. Do not turn to our wickedness; do not hide Your face from us, and do not ignore our plea. Be near to our cry; let Your kindness comfort us; before we call to You, answer us, as it is said: And it shall be that before they call, I will answer; while they are still speaking, I will hear. For You, Hashem, are the One Who answers in time of trouble, Who redeems and rescues in every time of trouble and distress. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who answers His people Israel in time of trouble.

Heal us, Hashem, and we shall be healed; save us and we shall be saved, for You are our praise. And bring complete healing and cure for all our wounds, for You are a faithful and merciful God, King and Healer. Blessed are You, Hashem, Healer of the sick of His people Israel.

parts.text: Bless for us, Hashem our God, this year and all kinds of its produce for good, and grant
dew and rain for a blessing upon the face of the earth

and satisfy us from Your goodness, and bless our year like the good years, for blessing. For You are a good God Who does good, and Who blesses the years. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who blesses the years.

segs.text: Sound the great shofar for our freedom, raise a banner to gather our exiles, and gather us together from the four corners of the earth to our land. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who gathers the dispersed of His people Israel.

parts.text: Restore our judges as at first and our counselors as in the beginning, and remove from us sorrow and sighing, and reign over us, You alone, Hashem, with kindness and mercy, with righteousness and justice. Blessed are You, Hashem,
the King Who loves righteousness and justice.

segs.text: May there be no hope for informers, and may all the heretics and all the wicked perish in an instant; may all the enemies of Your people be swiftly cut down; and may the wicked kingdom be swiftly uprooted, crushed, cast down and humbled, speedily in our days. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who crushes enemies and humbles the arrogant.

Upon the righteous, upon the pious, upon the elders of Your people the House of Israel, upon the remnant of their scholars, upon the righteous converts, and upon us, may Your mercy be stirred, Hashem our God; and grant a good reward to all who truly trust in Your Name, and place our lot with them, so that we shall never be ashamed, for in You we have trusted. Blessed are You, Hashem, the Support and Trust of the righteous.

parts.text: And to Jerusalem, Your city, may You return in mercy, and dwell within it as You have spoken; and may You speedily establish within it the throne of David Your servant, and rebuild it soon, in our days, as an everlasting structure.
Blessed are You, Hashem, Builder of Jerusalem.

segs.text: Console, Hashem our God, the mourners of Zion and the mourners of Jerusalem, and the city that is mourning, ruined, scorned and desolate: mourning for being without her children, ruined of her dwellings, scorned of her glory, and desolate without inhabitant. She sits with her head covered, like a barren woman who has never given birth. Legions have devoured her, worshippers of strangers have taken possession of her; they have put Your people Israel to the sword and wickedly slain the devout ones of the Most High. Therefore Zion weeps bitterly and Jerusalem raises her voice: My heart, my heart, for the slain! My innards, my innards, for the slain! For You, Hashem, set her aflame with fire, and with fire You will in the future rebuild her, as it is said: And I will be to her, says Hashem, a wall of fire all around, and I will be for glory within her. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who consoles Zion and rebuilds Jerusalem.

Cause the offspring of David Your servant speedily to flourish, and raise his horn high through Your salvation, for we hope for Your salvation all day long. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who causes the horn of salvation to flourish.

Hear our voice, Hashem our God; merciful Father, have mercy on us, and accept our prayer with mercy and favor, for You are a God Who hears prayers and supplications; and from before You, our King, do not turn us away empty-handed.

Answer us, Hashem, answer us on this day of our fast, for we are in great distress. Do not turn to our wickedness; do not hide Your face from us, and do not ignore our plea. Be near to our cry; let Your kindness comfort us; before we call to You, answer us, as it is said: And it shall be that before they call, I will answer; while they are still speaking, I will hear. For You, Hashem, are the One Who answers in time of trouble, Who redeems and rescues in every time of trouble and distress.
For You hear the prayer of every mouth. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who hears prayer.

Be pleased, Hashem our God, with Your people Israel and turn to their prayer; restore the service to the Sanctuary of Your House; and accept in love and favor the fire-offerings of Israel and their prayer; and may the service of Your people Israel always be pleasing to You.

parts.text: Our God and God of our fathers, may there ascend, come, reach, be seen, be favored, be heard, be recalled and be remembered: our remembrance and our reckoning, the remembrance of our fathers, the remembrance of Mashiach son of David Your servant, the remembrance of Jerusalem Your holy city, and the remembrance of all Your people the House of Israel before You, for deliverance, for good, for grace, kindness and mercy, for good life and for peace, on this day of

Remember us, Hashem our God, on it for good; reckon us on it for blessing; and save us on it for good life. With a word of salvation and mercy, spare us and be gracious to us, and have mercy on us and save us, for our eyes are turned to You, for You are a gracious and merciful God and King.

segs.text: And may our eyes behold Your return to Zion in mercy. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who returns His Presence to Zion.

We thank You, for You are Hashem our God and God of our fathers forever and ever; Rock of our lives, Shield of our salvation, You are He from generation to generation. We will thank You and recount Your praise, for our lives which are committed into Your hand, and for our souls which are entrusted to You, and for Your miracles which are with us every day, and for Your wonders and Your favors at all times, evening, morning and noon. The Beneficent One, for Your mercies never end; the Merciful One, for Your kindnesses never cease; for we have always placed our hope in You.

The Rabbis' Modim: We thank You, for You are Hashem our God and God of our fathers, God of all flesh, our Creator, Creator of the beginning. Blessings and thanks to Your great and holy Name, for You have given us life and sustained us. So may You continue to give us life and sustain us, gather our exiles to the courtyards of Your Sanctuary, that we may observe Your statutes, do Your will, and serve You with a whole heart; for this we thank You. Blessed is the God of thanksgivings.
And for the miracles, for the redemption, for the mighty deeds, for the saving acts and for the wonders that You performed for our ancestors in those days, at this time.

In the days of Mattityahu, son of Yochanan the High Priest, the Hasmonean, and his sons, when the wicked Greek kingdom rose up against Your people Israel to make them forget Your Torah and to turn them away from the statutes of Your will, You, in Your abundant mercy, stood by them in their time of distress. You waged their battle, You judged their claim, You avenged their wrong. You delivered the strong into the hands of the weak, the many into the hands of the few, the impure into the hands of the pure, the wicked into the hands of the righteous, and the willful sinners into the hands of those who occupy themselves with Your Torah. You made a great and holy name for Yourself in Your world, and for Your people Israel You performed a great salvation and redemption to this very day. Afterward Your children came to the sanctuary of Your House, cleansed Your Temple, purified Your Sanctuary, kindled lights in Your holy courtyards, and established these eight days of Chanukah to give thanks and praise to Your great name.

In the days of Mordechai and Esther, in Shushan the capital, when the wicked Haman rose up against them and sought to destroy, slay and exterminate all the Jews, young and old, children and women, in one day, on the thirteenth of the twelfth month, which is the month of Adar, and to plunder their possessions. But You, in Your abundant mercy, nullified his counsel and frustrated his plan, and returned his reward upon his own head, and they hanged him and his sons on the gallows.
And for all of them, may Your Name be blessed, exalted and raised up continually, our King, forever and ever.
And inscribe all the children of Your covenant for a good life.

And all the living shall thank You, Selah, and praise Your great Name forever, for You are good; the God of our salvation and our help, Selah, the good God. Blessed are You, Hashem, Your Name is the Good, and to You it is fitting to give thanks.

Our God and God of our fathers, bless us with the threefold blessing in the Torah, written by the hand of Moses Your servant, spoken from the mouth of Aaron and his sons, the priests, Your holy people, as it is said: May Hashem bless you and guard you. Amen. May Hashem make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you. Amen. May Hashem lift up His face to you and grant you peace. Amen.

parts.text: Grant peace, goodness and blessing, life, grace, kindness and mercy, upon us and upon all Israel Your people. Bless us, our Father, all of us as one, with the light of Your countenance; for with the light of Your countenance You gave us, Hashem our God, a Torah of life and the love of kindness, righteousness, blessing, mercy, life and peace. And may it be good in Your eyes to bless Your people Israel at every time and at every hour with Your peace.

In the book of life, blessing and peace, good livelihood, salvation, consolation and good decrees, may we be remembered and inscribed before You, we and all Your people the House of Israel, for a good life and for peace.
Blessed are You, Hashem, Who blesses His people Israel with peace.

segs.text: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Hashem, my Rock and my Redeemer.

My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceit. To those who curse me, let my soul be silent, and let my soul be like dust to all. Open my heart to Your Torah, and let my soul pursue Your commandments. As for all who plan evil against me, speedily annul their counsel and frustrate their plans. Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of Hashem driving them on. That Your beloved ones may be rescued, save with Your right hand and answer me. Act for the sake of Your Name; act for the sake of Your right hand; act for the sake of Your Torah; act for the sake of Your holiness. May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Hashem, my Rock and my Redeemer.

parts.text: in His heights, may He make peace upon us and upon all Israel; and say, Amen.

segs.text: May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that the Holy Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant us our portion in Your Torah.

segs.en: After the Amidah, say the Viduy:
segs.text: <small>אחר שמונה עשרה יאמר וידוי:</small>

אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵֽי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, תָּבֽוֹא לְפָנֶֽיךָ תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ, וְאַל־תִּתְעַלַּֽם מִתְּחִנָּתֵֽנוּ, שֶׁאֵֽין אָֽנוּ עַזֵּֽי פָנִֽים וּקְשֵֽׁי עֹֽרֶף, לוֹמַֽר לְפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, צַדִּיקִֽים אֲנַֽחְנוּ וְלֹא חָטָֽאנוּ, אֲבָל אֲנַֽחְנוּ וַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ חָטָֽאנוּ:

אָשַֽׁמְנוּ. בָּגַֽדְנוּ. גָּזַֽלְנוּ. דִּבַּֽרְנוּ דֹּֽפִי: הֶעֱוִֽינוּ. וְהִרְשַֽׁעְנוּ. זַֽדְנוּ. חָמַֽסְנוּ. טָפַֽלְנוּ שֶֽׁקֶר: יָעַֽצְנוּ רָע. כִּזַּֽבְנוּ. לַֽצְנוּ. מָרַֽדְנוּ. נִאַֽצְנוּ. סָרַֽרְנוּ. עָוִֽינוּ. פָּשַֽׁעְנוּ. צָרַֽרְנוּ. קִשִּֽׁינוּ עֹֽרֶף: רָשַֽׁעְנוּ. שִׁחַֽתְנוּ. תִּעַֽבְנוּ. תָּעִֽינוּ. תִּעְתָּֽעְנוּ:
סַֽרְנוּ מִמִּצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ הַטּוֹבִֽים וְלֹא־שָֽׁוָה לָֽנוּ: וְאַתָּֽה צַדִּיק עַל כָּל־הַבָּא עָלֵֽינוּ כִּי־אֱמֶת עָשִֹֽיתָ וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ:

אֵל אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּֽיִם אַתָּֽה וּבַֽעַל הָרַחֲמִים נִקְרֵֽאתָ, וְדֶרֶךְ תְּשׁוּבָה הוֹרֵֽיתָ. גְּדֻלַּֽת רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וַחֲסָדֶֽיךָ, תִּזְכּוֹר הַיּוֹם וּבְכָל־יוֹם לְזֶֽרַע יְדִידֶֽיךָ. תֵּֽפֶן אֵלֵֽינוּ בְּרַחֲמִים, כִּי אַתָּֽה־הוּא בַּֽעַל הָרַחֲמִים. בְּתַחֲנוּן וּבִתְפִלָּה פָּנֶֽיךָ נְקַדֵּם, כְּהוֹדַֽעְתָּ לֶעָנָיו מִקֶּֽדֶם. מֵחֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ שׁוּב, כְּמוֹ בְּתוֹרָתְךָ כָּתוּב. וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶֽיךָ נֶחֱסֶה וְנִתְלוֹנָן, כְּיוֹם וַיֵּֽרֶד יְיָ בֶּעָנָן: תַּעֲבוֹר עַל פֶּֽשַׁע וְתִמְחֶה אָשָֽׁם, כְּיוֹם וַיִּתְיַצֵּב עִמּוֹ שָׁם. תַּאֲזִין שַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ וְתַקְשִׁיב מֶֽנּוּ מַאֲמָר, כְּיוֹם וַיִּקְרָא בְשֵׁם יְיָ וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:
וַיַּעֲבֹֽר יְיָ | עַל־פָּנָיו וַיִּקְרָא
יְיָ | יְיָ אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּֽיִם וְרַב־חֶֽסֶד וֶאֱמֶת: נֹצֵֽר חֶֽסֶד לָאֲלָפִים נשֵֹֽׁא עָוֹֽן וָפֶֽשַׁע וְחַטָּאָֽה וְנַקֵּֽה:
רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן חָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ רַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ:

לְדָוִד אֵלֶיךָ יְיָ נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּֽׂא׃ אֱֽלֹהַי בְּךָ בָטַחְתִּי אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה, אַל־יַעַלְצוּ אוֹיְבַי לִֽי׃ גַּם כׇּל־קֹוֶיךָ לֹא יֵבֹשׁוּ, יֵבֹשׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִים רֵיקָֽם׃ דְּרָכֶיךָ יְיָ הוֹדִיעֵנִי, אֹרְחוֹתֶיךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃ הַדְרִיכֵנִי בַאֲמִתֶּךָ ׀ וְֽלַמְּדֵנִי כִּֽי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי, אוֹתְךָ קִוִּיתִי כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃ זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶיךָ יְיָ, וַחֲסָדֶיךָ, כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵֽמָּה׃ חַטֹּאות נְעוּרַי ׀ וּפְשָׁעַי אַל־תִּזְכֹּר כְּחַסְדְּךָ זְכׇר־לִי־אַתָּה, לְמַעַן טוּבְךָ יְהֹוָֽה׃ טוֹב־וְיָשָׁר יְיָ, עַל־כֵּן יוֹרֶה חַטָּאִים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃ יַדְרֵךְ עֲנָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט, וִילַמֵּד עֲנָוִים דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃ כׇּל־אׇרְחוֹת יְיָ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת, לְנֹצְרֵי בְרִיתוֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃ לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ יְיָ וְֽסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֺנִי כִּי רַב־הֽוּא׃ מִי־זֶה הָאִישׁ יְרֵא יְיָ, יוֹרֶנּוּ בְּדֶרֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃ נַפְשׁוֹ בְּטוֹב תָּלִין וְזַרְעוֹ יִירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃ סוֹד יְיָ לִירֵאָיו, וּבְרִיתוֹ לְהוֹדִיעָֽם׃ עֵינַי תָּמִיד אֶל־יְיָ, כִּי הֽוּא־יוֹצִיא מֵרֶשֶׁת רַגְלָֽי׃ פְּנֵה־אֵלַי וְחׇנֵּנִי, כִּֽי־יָחִיד וְעָנִי אָֽנִי׃ צָרוֹת לְבָבִי הִרְחִיבוּ, מִמְּצוּקוֹתַי הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי׃ רְאֵה עׇנְיִי וַעֲמָלִי, וְשָׂא לְכׇל־חַטֹּאותָֽי׃ רְאֵֽה־אֹיְבַי כִּי־רָבּוּ, וְשִׂנְאַת חָמָס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי׃ שׇׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵנִי, אַל־אֵבוֹשׁ כִּֽי־חָסִיתִי בָֽךְ׃ תֹּם־וָיֹשֶׁר יִצְּרוּנִי, כִּי קִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃ פְּדֵה אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל צָרוֹתָֽיו׃ וְהוּא יִפְדֶּה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִכֹּל עֲו‍ֹנֹתָיו:

parts.en: On public fast days and during the Ten Days of Repentance, say Avinu Malkeinu here:
parts.text: <small>בתענית ציבור ובעשי״ת אומרים כאן אבינו מלכנו.</small>

אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חָטָֽאנוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ אֵין לָֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ

עָלֵֽינוּ שָׁנָה טוֹבָה:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ בַּטֵּל מֵעָלֵֽינוּ כָּל־גְּזֵרוֹת קָשׁוֹת:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ בַּטֵּל מַחְשְׁבוֹת שׂוֹנְאֵֽינוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הָפֵר עֲצַת אוֹיְבֵֽינוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כַּלֵּה כָּל־צַר וּמַשְׂטִין מֵעָלֵֽינוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ סְתוֹם פִּיּוֹת מַשְׂטִינֵֽנוּ וּמְקַטְרִיגֵֽנוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כַּלֵּה דֶּֽבֶר וְחֶֽרֶב וְרָעָב וּשְׁבִי וּמַשְׁחִית מִבְּנֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מְנַע מַגֵּפָה מִנַּחֲלָתֶֽךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ סְלַח וּמְחַל לְכָל־עֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מְחֵה וְהַעֲבֵר פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מְחוֹק בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים כָּל־שִׁטְרֵי חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הַחֲזִירֵֽנוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶֽיךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ שְׁלַח רְפוּאָה שְׁלֵמָה לְחוֹלֵי עַמֶּֽךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ קְרַע רֽוֹעַ גְּזַר דִּינֵֽנוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ זָכְרֵֽנוּ בְּזִכָּרוֹן טוֹב לְפָנֶֽיךָ:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְבֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר חַיִּים טוֹבִים:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְבֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר גְּאֻלָּה וִישׁוּעָה:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְבֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר פַּרְנָסָה וְכַלְכָּלָה:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְבֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר זְכֻיּוֹת:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְבֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר סְלִיחָה וּמְחִילָה:

אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ זָכְרֵֽנוּ לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ זָכְרֵֽנוּ לִגְאֻלָּה וִישׁוּעָה:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ זָכְרֵֽנוּ לְפַרְנָסָה וְכַלְכָּלָה:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ זָכְרֵֽנוּ לִזְכֻיּוֹת:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ זָכְרֵֽנוּ לִסְלִיחָה וּמְחִילָה:]

אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הַצְמַח לָֽנוּ יְשׁוּעָה בְּקָרוֹב:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הָרֵם קֶֽרֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הָרֵם קֶֽרֶן מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מַלֵּא יָדֵֽינוּ מִבִּרְכוֹתֶֽיךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מַלֵּא אֲסָמֵֽינוּ שָׂבָע:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ שְׁמַע קוֹלֵֽנוּ חוּס וְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ קַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְרָצוֹן אֶת־תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ פְּתַח שַׁעֲרֵי שָׁמַֽיִם לִתְפִלָּתֵֽנוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ זָכוּר כִּי־עָפָר אֲנָֽחְנוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ נָא אַל תְּשִׁיבֵֽנוּ רֵיקָם מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ תְּהֵא הַשָּׁעָה הַזֹּאת שְׁעַת רַחֲמִים וְעֵת רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חֲמוֹל עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל עוֹלָלֵֽינוּ וְטַפֵּֽנוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן הֲרוּגִים עַל שֵׁם קָדְשֶֽׁךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן טְבוּחִים עַל יִחוּדֶֽךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן בָּאֵי בָאֵשׁ וּבַמַּֽיִם עַל קִדּוּשׁ שְׁמֶֽךָ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ נְקוֹם נִקְמַת דַּם עֲבָדֶֽיךָ הַשָּׁפוּךְ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַנְךָ אִם לֺא לְמַעֲנֵֽנוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַנְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן רַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא שֶׁנִּקְרָא עָלֵֽינוּ:
אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חָנֵּֽנוּ וַעֲנֵֽנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּֽנוּ מַעֲשִׂים עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶֽסֶד וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ:

segs.text: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ אָבִינוּ אָֽתָּה: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ אֵין לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ רַחֵֽם עָלֵינוּ: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ חָנֵּנוּ וַעֲנֵנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּנוּ מַעֲשִׂים עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶסֶד לְמַעַן שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ:

וַאֲנַחְנוּ לֹא נֵדַע מַה־נַּעֲשֶׂה, כִּי עָלֶיךָ עֵינֵינוּ: זְכֹר רַחֲמֶיךָ יְיָ, וַחֲסָדֶיךָ, כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵמָּה: יְהִי־חַסְדְּךָ יְיָ עָלֵינוּ, כַּאֲשֶׁר יִחַלְנוּ לָךְ: אַל־תִּזְכָּר־לָנוּ עֲו‍ֹנוֹת רִאשׁוֹנִים, מַהֵר יְקַדְּמוּנוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, כִּי דַלּוֹנוּ מְאֹד: חָנֵּנוּ יְיָ חָנֵּנוּ, כִּי־רַב שָׂבַעְנוּ בוּז: בְּרֹֽגֶז רַחֵם תִּזְכּוֹר: בְּרֹֽגֶז עֲקֵדָה תִּזְכּוֹר: בְּרֹֽגֶז תְּמִימוֹת תִּזְכּוֹר: בְּרֹֽגֶז אַהֲבָה תִזְכּוֹר: יְיָ הוֹשִׁיעָה, הַמֶּלֶךְ יַעֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם־קָרְאֵנוּ: כִּי־הוּא יָדַע יִצְרֵנוּ, זָכוּר כִּי־עָפָר אֲנָחְנוּ: עָזְרֵנוּ | אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ עַל־דְּבַר כְּבוֹד־שְׁמֶךָ, וְהַצִּילֵנוּ וְכַפֵּר עַל חַטֹּאתֵינוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ:
<small>הש״ץ אומר קדיש שלם</small>

parts.text: בְּעָלְמָֽא דִּי בְרָֽא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִֽיךְ מַלְכוּתֵֽהּ,
בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַֽן קָרִיב וְאִמְרֽוּ אָמֵֽן: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּֽא מְבָרַֽךְ לְעָלַֽם וּלְעָלְמֵֽי עָלְמַיָּֽא. יִתְבָּרֵֽךְ,

segs.text: תִּתְקַבֵּל צְלוֹתְהוֹן וּבָעוּתְהוֹן דְּכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, קֳדָם אֲבוּהוֹן דִּי בִשְׁמַיָּא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּֽא מִן־שְׁמַיָּֽא וְחַיִּֽים טוֹבִֽים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְאִמְרֽוּ אָמֵֽן:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו הוּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה שָׁלֽוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְאִמְרֽוּ אָמֵֽן:

segs.text: Our God and God of our fathers, may our prayer come before You, and do not ignore our supplication, for we are not so brazen and stiff-necked as to say before You, Hashem, our God and God of our fathers: We are righteous and have not sinned; but indeed, we and our fathers have sinned.

We are guilty, we have betrayed, we have robbed, we have spoken slander. We have acted perversely, we have done wrong, we have sinned willfully, we have done violence, we have accused falsely. We have given evil counsel, we have deceived, we have scoffed, we have rebelled, we have provoked, we have turned away, we have committed iniquity, we have transgressed, we have oppressed, we have been stiff-necked. We have acted wickedly, we have corrupted, we have acted abominably, we have strayed, we have led others astray.

We have turned away from Your commandments and from Your good laws, and it has not profited us. But You are righteous in all that has come upon us, for You have acted truthfully, and we have acted wickedly.

God, slow to anger are You, and Master of mercy You are called, and the way of repentance You have taught. The greatness of Your mercy and Your kindnesses, remember today and every day for the offspring of Your beloved ones. Turn to us in mercy, for You are the Master of mercy. With supplication and prayer we come before You, as You made known to the humble in ancient times. From Your fierce anger turn back, as it is written in Your Torah. And in the shadow of Your wings we take refuge and find shelter, as on the day when Hashem descended in the cloud. Pass over transgression and wipe away guilt, as on the day when He stood with him there. Hear our cry and listen to our plea, as on the day when He called out the Name of Hashem; and there it was said:
And Hashem passed before him and proclaimed:

Hashem, Hashem, God, merciful and gracious, slow to anger and abundant in kindness and truth; preserving kindness for thousands of generations, forgiving iniquity, transgression and sin, and cleansing.
Merciful and gracious One, we have sinned before You; have mercy on us and save us.

Of David. To You, Hashem, I lift up my soul. My God, in You I trust; let me not be ashamed; let not my enemies exult over me. Indeed, none who hope in You shall be ashamed; ashamed shall be those who act treacherously without cause. Make Your ways known to me, Hashem; teach me Your paths. Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; for You I have hoped all day long. Remember Your mercies, Hashem, and Your kindnesses, for they are from of old. The sins of my youth and my transgressions do not remember; according to Your kindness remember me, for the sake of Your goodness, Hashem. Good and upright is Hashem; therefore He instructs sinners in the way. He guides the humble in justice, and teaches the humble His way. All the paths of Hashem are kindness and truth, for those who keep His covenant and His testimonies. For Your Name's sake, Hashem, pardon my iniquity, for it is great. Who is the man who fears Hashem? He will instruct him in the way he should choose. His soul shall dwell in goodness, and his offspring shall inherit the land. The counsel of Hashem is for those who fear Him, and His covenant, to make them know it. My eyes are ever toward Hashem, for He will free my feet from the net. Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am alone and afflicted. The troubles of my heart are enlarged; bring me out of my distresses. See my affliction and my toil, and forgive all my sins. See how many my enemies are, and with violent hatred they hate me. Guard my soul and rescue me; let me not be ashamed, for I have taken refuge in You. May integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I have hoped in You. Redeem Israel, O God, from all its troubles. And He will redeem Israel from all its iniquities.

parts.text: Our Father, our King, we have sinned before You. Our Father, our King, we have no king but You. Our Father, our King, deal with us for Your Name's sake. Our Father, our King,

for us a good year. Our Father, our King, annul all harsh decrees against us. Our Father, our King, annul the plans of our enemies. Our Father, our King, foil the counsel of our enemies. Our Father, our King, eliminate every oppressor and adversary from upon us. Our Father, our King, close the mouths of our adversaries and accusers. Our Father, our King, eliminate pestilence, sword, famine, captivity, destruction and plague from the children of Your covenant. Our Father, our King, prevent the plague from Your inheritance. Our Father, our King, forgive and pardon all our iniquities. Our Father, our King, wipe away and remove our transgressions from before Your eyes. Our Father, our King, erase in Your abundant mercy all the records of our debts. Our Father, our King, bring us back in complete repentance before You. Our Father, our King, send a complete healing to the sick of Your people. Our Father, our King, tear up the evil decree against us. Our Father, our King, remember us with a good memory before You.

Our Father, our King, inscribe us in the book of good life. Our Father, our King, inscribe us in the book of redemption and salvation. Our Father, our King, inscribe us in the book of livelihood and sustenance. Our Father, our King, inscribe us in the book of merits. Our Father, our King, inscribe us in the book of forgiveness and pardon.

Our Father, our King, remember us for good life. Our Father, our King, remember us for redemption and salvation. Our Father, our King, remember us for livelihood and sustenance. Our Father, our King, remember us for merits. Our Father, our King, remember us for forgiveness and pardon.

Our Father, our King, cause our salvation to sprout soon. Our Father, our King, raise the horn of Israel Your people. Our Father, our King, raise the horn of Your Mashiach. Our Father, our King, fill our hands with Your blessings. Our Father, our King, fill our storehouses with plenty. Our Father, our King, hear our voice, spare us and have mercy on us. Our Father, our King, accept our prayer with mercy and favor. Our Father, our King, open the gates of heaven to our prayer. Our Father, our King, remember that we are dust. Our Father, our King, please do not turn us away empty from before You. Our Father, our King, may this hour be an hour of mercy and a time of favor before You. Our Father, our King, have compassion on us, on our infants and on our little ones. Our Father, our King, act for the sake of those killed for Your holy Name. Our Father, our King, act for the sake of those slaughtered for Your Oneness. Our Father, our King, act for the sake of those who went through fire and water for the sanctification of Your Name. Our Father, our King, avenge the spilled blood of Your servants. Our Father, our King, act for Your sake if not for ours. Our Father, our King, act for Your sake and save us. Our Father, our King, act for the sake of Your abundant mercy. Our Father, our King, act for the sake of Your great, mighty and awesome Name by which we are called. Our Father, our King, be gracious to us and answer us, for we have no worthy deeds; deal with us in charity and kindness, and save us.

segs.text: Our Father, our King, You are our Father. Our Father, our King, we have no king but You. Our Father, our King, have mercy on us. Our Father, our King, be gracious to us and answer us, for we have no worthy deeds; deal with us in charity and kindness for the sake of Your great Name, and save us.

But we do not know what to do, for our eyes are upon You. Remember Your mercy, Hashem, and Your kindnesses, for they are from of old. May Your kindness, Hashem, be upon us, as we have hoped for You. Do not remember against us the iniquities of those before us; may Your mercies speedily meet us, for we have become very poor. Be gracious to us, Hashem, be gracious to us, for we are thoroughly sated with contempt. In wrath, remember mercy. In wrath, remember the Binding of Isaac. In wrath, remember wholeheartedness. In wrath, remember love. Hashem, save! May the King answer us on the day we call. For He knows our nature; He remembers that we are dust. Help us, God of our salvation, for the sake of the glory of Your Name; rescue us and atone for our sins for the sake of Your Name.

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. Amen. In the world that He created according to His will; and may He establish His kingdom, and cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. Amen. In your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say: Amen. May His great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, uplifted and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. Blessed is He. Amen. Beyond all the blessings and songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say: Amen.
May the prayers and supplications of all Israel be accepted before their Father in heaven; and say: Amen.
May there be abundant peace from heaven, and good life, for us and for all Israel; and say: Amen.

parts.text: in His heights, may He make peace upon us and upon all Israel; and say, Amen.

parts.en: From Rosh Chodesh Elul until Hoshana Raba, say here:
parts.gloss: LeDavid (Psalm 27) is recited before Aleinu in Mincha during this period
parts.text: <small>מר״ח אלול עד הושענא רבא אומרים כאן:</small>

לְדָוִד יְיָ אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא, יְיָ מָעוֹז־חַיַּי מִמִּי אֶפְחָד: בִּקְרֹב עָלַי מְרֵעִים לֶאֱכֹל אֶת־בְּשָׂרִי צָרַי וְאֹיְבַי לִי, הֵֽמָּה כָשְׁלוּ וְנָפָֽלוּ: אִם־תַּחֲנֶה עָלַי מַחֲנֶה לֺא־יִירָא לִבִּי, אִם־תָּקוּם עָלַי מִלְחָמָה, בְּזֹאת אֲנִי בוֹטֵֽחַ: אַחַת שָׁאַֽלְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְיָ אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ, שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְיָ כָּל־יְמֵי חַיַּי, לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹֽעַם־יְיָ וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ: כִּי יִצְפְּנֵֽנִי בְּסֻכֹּה בְּיוֹם רָעָה יַסְתִּרֵֽנִי בְּסֵֽתֶר אָהֳלוֹ, בְּצוּר יְרוֹמְמֵֽנִי: וְעַתָּה יָרוּם רֹאשִׁי עַל אֹיְבַי סְבִיבוֹתָי, וְאֶזְבְּחָה בְאָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵי תְרוּעָה, אָשִֽׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּרָה לַייָ: שְׁמַע־יְיָ קוֹלִי אֶקְרָא, וְחָנֵּֽנִי וַעֲנֵֽנִי: לְךָ אָמַר לִבִּי, בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָי, אֶת־פָּנֶֽיךָ יְיָ אֲבַקֵּשׁ: אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶֽיךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי, אַל תַּט־בְּאַף עַבְדֶּֽךָ עֶזְרָתִי הָיִֽיתָ, אַל־תִּטְּשֵֽׁנִי וְאַל־תַּעַזְבֵֽנִי אֱלֺהֵי יִשְׁעִי: כִּי־אָבִי וְאִמִּי עֲזָבֽוּנִי, וַייָ יַאַסְפֵֽנִי: הוֹרֵֽנִי יְיָ דַּרְכֶּֽךָ וּנְחֵֽנִי בְּאֹֽרַח מִישׁוֹר, לְמַֽעַן שׁוֹרְרָי: אַל־תִּתְּנֵֽנִי בְּנֶֽפֶשׁ צָרָי, כִּי קָֽמוּ־בִי עֵֽדֵי־שֶֽׁקֶר וִיפֵֽחַ חָמָס: לוּלֵא הֶאֱמַֽנְתִּי לִרְאוֹת בְּטוּב־יְיָ בְּאֶֽרֶץ חַיִּים: קַוֵּה אֶל־יְיָ, חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ, וְקַוֵּה אֶל־יְיָ:

עָלֵֽינוּ לְשַׁבֵּֽחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל, לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית, שֶׁלֺּא עָשָֽׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת, וְלֺא שָׂמָֽנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה, שֶׁלֺּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵֽנוּ כָּהֶם, וְגוֹרָלֵֽנוּ כְּכָל־הֲמוֹנָם, שֶׁהֵם מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לְהֶֽבֶל וְלָרִיק:

לִפְנֵי מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ, בָּרוּךְ הוּא: שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַֽיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָֽרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים, הוּא אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ אֵין עוֹד, אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּֽנוּ, אֶֽפֶס זוּלָתוֹ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל־לְבָבֶֽךָ, כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֺהִים בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל, וְעַל־הָאָֽרֶץ מִתָּֽחַת, אֵין עוֹד:

segs.text: וְעַל־כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ, לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶֽרֶת עֻזֶּֽךָ, לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים מִן הָאָֽרֶץ וְהָאֱלִילִים כָּרוֹת יִכָּרֵתוּן, לְתַקֵּן עוֹלָם בְּמַלְכוּת שַׁדַּי: וְכָל־בְּנֵי־בָשָׂר יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁמֶֽךָ, לְהַפְנוֹת אֵלֶֽיךָ כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי אָֽרֶץ. יַכִּֽירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל־יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, כִּי־לְךָ תִכְרַע כָּל־בֶּֽרֶךְ, תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל־לָשׁוֹן: לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְיָ אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ יִכְרְעוּ וְיִפּֽוֹלוּ, וְלִכְבוֹד שִׁמְךָ יְקָר יִתֵּֽנוּ, וִיקַבְּלוּ כֻלָּם עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־עוֹל מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ, וְתִמְלוֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, כִּי הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁלְּךָ הִיא, וּלְעֽוֹלְמֵי עַד תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ: יְיָ יִמְלֺךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד. וְנֶאֱמַר: וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶֽלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ, בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:
