parts.text: בְּעָלְמָֽא דִּי בְרָֽא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִֽיךְ מַלְכוּתֵֽהּ,
בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַֽן קָרִיב וְאִמְרֽוּ אָמֵֽן: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּֽא מְבָרַֽךְ לְעָלַֽם וּלְעָלְמֵֽי עָלְמַיָּֽא. יִתְבָּרֵֽךְ,

segs.text: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּֽא מִן־שְׁמַיָּֽא וְחַיִּֽים טוֹבִֽים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְאִמְרֽוּ אָמֵֽן:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו הוּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה שָׁלֽוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְאִמְרֽוּ אָמֵֽן:

segs.text: אַל־תִּירָא מִפַּחַד פִּתאֹם, וּמִשֹׁאַת רְשָׁעִים כִּי תָבֹא: עֻֽצוּ עֵצָה וְתֻפָר, דַּבְּרוּ דָבָר וְלֹא יָקוּם כִּי עִמָּנוּ אֵל: וְעַד זִקְנָה אֲנִי הוּא, וְעַד שֵׂיבָה אֲנִי אֶסְבֹּל: אֲנִי עָשִֽׂיתִי וַאֲנִי אֶשָׂא וַאֲנִי אֶסְבֹּל וַאֲמַלֵּט: אַךְ צַדִּיקִים יוֹדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ יֵשְׁבוּ יְשָׁרִים אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ׃

Of David. Hashem is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? Hashem is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid? When evildoers approach me to devour my flesh, my adversaries and my enemies, they stumble and fall. If an army encamps against me, my heart will not fear; if war arises against me, even then I will be confident. One thing I ask of Hashem, that I seek: to dwell in the house of Hashem all the days of my life, to behold the pleasantness of Hashem and to visit in His Temple. For He will hide me in His shelter on the day of evil; He will conceal me in the concealment of His tent; He will lift me up on a rock. And now my head will be raised above my enemies around me; and I will offer in His tent sacrifices with trumpet blasts; I will sing and make music to Hashem. Hear, Hashem, my voice when I call; be gracious to me and answer me. On Your behalf my heart says: “Seek My face”; Your face, Hashem, I will seek. Do not hide Your face from me; do not turn Your servant away in anger. You have been my help; do not abandon me and do not forsake me, God of my salvation. For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but Hashem will take me in. Teach me Your way, Hashem, and lead me on a level path because of my watchful enemies. Do not give me over to the will of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen against me, breathing out violence. Were it not that I believed I would see the goodness of Hashem in the land of the living! Hope in Hashem; be strong and let your heart take courage, and hope in Hashem.

It is our duty to praise the Master of all, to ascribe greatness to the Creator of the beginning, who has not made us like the nations of the lands, nor placed us like the families of the earth; who has not set our portion as theirs, nor our lot as all their multitude, for they bow down to vanity and emptiness. But we bend the knee, bow down and give thanks before the King, King of kings, the Holy One, blessed is He, who stretches out the heavens and founds the earth, whose seat of glory is in the heavens above and the abode of His mighty Presence is in the loftiest heights. He is our God; there is no other. Truly He is our King; there is nothing besides Him, as it is written in His Torah: “Know this day and take to heart that Hashem is God in the heavens above and on the earth below; there is no other.”

Therefore we hope to You, Hashem our God, soon to see the glory of Your might, to remove abominations from the earth and to have idols utterly cut off, to perfect the world under the kingdom of the Almighty. All humankind will call on Your name, to turn to You all the wicked of the earth. All the inhabitants of the world will recognize and know that to You every knee must bow and every tongue swear. Before You, Hashem our God, they will kneel and fall, and to Your glorious name give honor; and all will accept the yoke of Your kingdom, and You will reign over them soon and forever. For the kingdom is Yours, and to all eternity You will reign in glory, as it is written in Your Torah: “Hashem will reign forever and ever.” And it is said: “Hashem will be King over all the earth; on that day Hashem will be One and His name One.”

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. Amen. In the world that He created according to His will; and may He establish His kingdom, and cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. Amen. In your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say: Amen. May His great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, uplifted and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. Blessed is He. Amen. Beyond all the blessings and songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say: Amen.
May there be abundant peace from heaven, and good life, for us and for all Israel; and say: Amen.

parts.text: in His heights, may He make peace upon us and upon all Israel; and say, Amen.

segs.text: Do not fear sudden terror, nor the destruction of the wicked when it comes. Devise a plan and it will be foiled; speak a word and it will not stand, for God is with us. Even to old age I am the same, and even to gray hairs I will carry you; I have made you and I will bear you, and I will carry and rescue. Surely the righteous will thank Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֹן וְלֹא־יַשְׁחִית וְהִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ וְלֹא־יָעִיר כָּל־חֲמָתוֹ: יְיָ הוֹשִׁיעָה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ יַעֲנֵֽנוּ בְיוֹם־קָרְאֵֽנוּ:

parts.text: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת הִנֵּה  בָּרְכוּ אֶת־יְיָ כׇּל־עַבְדֵי יְיָ הָעֹמְדִים בְּבֵית־יְיָ בַּלֵּילוֹת׃ שְׂאוּ־יְדֵכֶם קֹדֶשׁ וּבָרְכוּ אֶת־יְיָ׃ יְבָרֶכְךָ יְיָ מִצִּיּוֹן עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃ יוֹמָם  יְצַוֶּה יְיָ  חַסְדּוֹ וּבַלַּיְלָה שִׁירֹה עִמִּי תְּפִלָּה לְאֵל חַיָּי׃ וּתְשׁוּעַת צַדִּיקִים מֵיְיָ מָעוּזָּם בְּעֵת צָרָה׃ וַיַּעְזְרֵם יְיָ וַיְפַלְּטֵם יְפַלְּטֵם מֵרְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם כִּי־חָסוּ בוֹ׃ יְיָ צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ,
בְּעָלְמָֽא דִּי בְרָֽא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִֽיךְ מַלְכוּתֵֽהּ,
אָמֵֽן: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּֽא מְבָרַֽךְ לְעָלַֽם וּלְעָלְמֵֽי עָלְמַיָּֽא.

segs.text: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר בִּדְבָרוֹ מַעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים, בְּחָכְמָה פּוֹתֵֽחַ שְׁעָרִים, וּבִתְבוּנָה מְשַׁנֶּה עִתִּים, וּמַחֲלִיף אֶת־הַזְּמַנִּים וּמְסַדֵּר אֶת־הַכּוֹכָבִים, בְּמִשְׁמְרוֹתֵיהֶם בָּרָקִֽיעַ, כִּרְצוֹנוֹ. בּוֹרֵא יוֹם וָלָֽיְלָה, גּוֹלֵל אוֹר מִפְּנֵי חֽשֶׁךְ, וְחֽשֶׁךְ מִפְּנֵי אוֹר. וּמַעֲבִיר יוֹם וּמֵבִיא לָֽיְלָה, וּמַבְדִּיל בֵּין יוֹם וּבֵין לָֽיְלָה, יְיָ צְבָאוֹת שְׁמוֹ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּעֲרִיב עֲרָבִים:

parts.text: תּוֹרָה וּמִצְוֹת חֻקִּים וּמִשְׁפָּטִים אוֹתָֽנוּ לִמַּֽדְתָּ. עַל כֵּן יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ,
וְנִשְׂמַח בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָתְךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד. כִּי הֵם חַיֵּֽינוּ וְאֹֽרֶךְ יָמֵֽינוּ,
אַל תָּסִיר) מִמֶּֽנּוּ לְעוֹלָמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ,

segs.text: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ יְיָ | אֶחָד:
<small>בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:</small>

וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת יְיָ אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ בְּכָל֯־לְ֯בָבְךָ וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל־מְאֹדֶֽךָ: וְהָיוּ הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵֽלֶּה אֲשֶׁר֯ אָ֯נֹכִי מְצַוְּךָ הַיּוֹם עַל֯־לְ֯בָבֶֽךָ: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּם לְבָנֶֽיךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּֽרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ: וּקְשַׁרְתָּם לְאוֹת עַל֯־יָ֯דֶֽךָ וְהָיוּ לְטֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֶֽיךָ: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזֻזוֹת בֵּיתֶֽךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ:

וְהָיָה אִם־שָׁמֹֽעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל־מִצְוֹתַי אֲשֶׁר֯ אָ֯נֹכִי מְצַוֶּה אֶתְכֶם הַיּוֹם לְאַהֲבָה אֶת־יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם וּלְעָבְדוֹ בְּכָל֯־לְ֯בַבְכֶם וּבְכָל־נַפְשְׁכֶם: וְנָתַתִּי מְטַר֯־אַ֯רְצְכֶם בְּעִתּוֹ֯ י֯וֹרֶה וּמַלְקוֹשׁ וְאָסַפְתָּ דְגָנֶֽךָ וְתִירשְׁךָ וְיִצְהָרֶֽךָ: וְנָתַתִּי עֵֽשֶׂב֯ בְּ֯שָׂדְךָ לִבְהֶמְתֶּֽךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ: הִשָּׁמְרוּ לָכֶם פֶּן֯־יִ֯פְתֶּה לְבַבְכֶם וְסַרְתֶּם וַעֲבַדְתֶּם אֱלֹהִים֯ אֲ֯חֵרִים וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶם לָהֶם: וְחָרָה אַף־יְיָ בָּכֶם וְעָצַר֯ אֶ֯ת־הַשָּׁמַֽיִם וְלֹּא֯־יִ֯הְיֶה מָטָר וְהָאֲדָמָה לֹא תִתֵּן אֶת֯־יְ֯בוּלָהּ וַאֲבַדְתֶּם֯ מְ֯הֵרָה מֵעַל הָאָֽרֶץ הַטֹּבָה אֲשֶׁר֯ יְ֯יָ נֹתֵן לָכֶם: וְשַׂמְתֶּם֯ אֶ֯ת־דְּבָרַי֯ אֵֽ֯לֶּה עַל֯־לְ֯בַבְכֶם וְעַל־נַפְשְׁכֶם וּקְשַׁרְתֶּם֯ אֹ֯תָם לְאוֹת עַל֯־יֶ֯דְכֶם וְהָיוּ לְטוֹטָפֹת בֵּין עֵינֵיכֶם: וְלִמַּדְתֶּם֯ אֹ֯תָם אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶם לְדַבֵּר בָּם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ בְּבֵיתֶֽךָ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ בַדֶּֽרֶךְ וּבְשָׁכְבְּךָ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ: וּכְתַבְתָּם עַל־מְזוּזוֹת בֵּיתֶֽךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ: לְמַֽעַן֯ יִ֯רְבּוּ יְמֵיכֶם וִימֵי בְנֵיכֶם עַל הָאֲדָמָה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע יְיָ לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶם לָתֵת לָהֶם כִּימֵי הַשָּׁמַֽיִם עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ:

וַֽיֹּאמֶר֯ יְ֯יָ אֶ֯ל־משֶׁה לֵּאמֹר: דַּבֵּר֯ אֶ֯ל־בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָמַרְתָּ אֲלֵהֶם וְעָשׂוּ לָהֶם צִיצִת עַל־כַּנְפֵי בִגְדֵיהֶם לְדֹרֹתָם וְנָתְנוּ עַל־צִיצִת הַכָּנָף֯ פְּ֯תִיל תְּכֵֽלֶת: וְהָיָה לָכֶם לְצִיצִת וּרְאִיתֶם֯ אֹ֯תוֹ וּזְכַרְתֶּם֯ אֶ֯ת־כָּל־מִצְוֹת֯ יְ֯יָ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֯ אֹ֯תָם וְלֹא תָתֽוּרוּ אַחֲרֵי לְבַבְכֶם וְאַחֲרֵי עֵינֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁר֯־אַ֯תֶּם זֹנִים֯ אַ֯חֲרֵיהֶם: לְמַֽעַן תִּזְכְּרוּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶם֯ אֶ֯ת־כָּל־מִצְוֹתָי וִהְיִיתֶם קְדשִׁים לֵאלֹהֵיכֶם: אֲנִי יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֯ אֲ֯שֶׁר הוֹצֵֽאתִי אֶתְכֶם֯ מֵ֯אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַֽיִם לִהְיוֹת לָכֶם לֵאלֹהִים֯ אֲ֯נִי יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֯:

אֱמֶת, וֶאֱמוּנָה כָּל־זֹאת, וְקַיָּם עָלֵֽינוּ, כִּי הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וְאֵין זוּלָתוֹ, וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ. הַפּוֹדֵֽנוּ מִיַּד מְלָכִים, מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הַגּוֹאֲלֵֽנוּ מִכַּף כָּל הֶעָרִיצִים. הָאֵל הַנִּפְרָע לָֽנוּ מִצָּרֵֽינוּ וְהַמְשַׁלֵּם גְּמוּל לְכָל־אֹיְבֵי נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ: הָעֹשֶׂה גְדוֹלוֹת עַד־אֵין חֵֽקֶר, וְנִפְלָאוֹת עַד־אֵין מִסְפָּר: הַשָּׂם נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ בַּחַיִּים, וְלֹא־נָתַן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֵֽנוּ. הַמַּדְרִיכֵֽנוּ עַל־בָּמוֹת אֹיְבֵֽינוּ, וַיָּֽרֶם קַרְנֵֽנוּ עַל־כָּל־שׂוֹנְאֵֽינוּ: הָאֵל הָעֹֽשֶׂה־לָּֽנוּ נְקָמָה בְּפַרְעֹה, וְאוֹתוֹת וּמוֹפְתִים בְּאַדְמַת בְּנֵי־חָם. הַמַּכֶּה בְעֶבְרָתוֹ כָּל־בְּכוֹרֵי מִצְרָֽיִם, וַיּוֹצֵא אֶת־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם לְחֵרוּת עוֹלָם. הַמַּעֲבִיר בָּנָיו בֵּין גִּזְרֵי יַם־סוּף, וְאֶת־רוֹדְפֵיהֶם וְאֶת־שׂוֹנְאֵיהֶם בִּתְהוֹמוֹת טִבַּע, וְרָאוּ בָנָיו גְּבוּרָתוֹ, שִׁבְּחוּ וְהוֹדוּ לִשְׁמוֹ. וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בְרָצוֹן קִבְּלוּ עֲלֵיהֶם, משֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְךָ עָנוּ שִׁירָה בְּשִׂמְחָה רַבָּה, וְאָמְרוּ כֻלָּם:

מִי־כָמֹֽכָה בָּאֵלִם יְיָ, מִי כָּמֹֽכָה נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ, נוֹרָא תְהִלֹּת עֹֽשֵׂה־פֶלֶא: מַלְכוּתְךָ רָאוּ בָנֶֽיךָ, בּוֹקֵֽעַ יָם לִפְנֵי משֶׁה, זֶה אֵלִי עָנוּ וְאָמְרוּ: יְיָ יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד. וְנֶאֱמַר כִּי־פָדָה יְיָ אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וּגְאָלוֹ מִיַּד חָזָק מִמֶּֽנּוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, גָּאַל יִשְׂרָאֵל:

הַשְׁכִּיבֵֽנוּ אָבִינוּ לְשָׁלוֹם, וְהַעֲמִידֵֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם וְתַקְּנֵֽנוּ בְּעֵצָה טוֹבָה מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ מְהֵרָה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ, וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵֽינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶֽךָ. וְהָגֵן בַּעֲדֵֽנוּ, וְהָסֵר מֵעָלֵֽינוּ אוֹיֵב, דֶּֽבֶר וְחֶֽרֶב וְרָעָב, וְיָגוֹן. וְהָסֵר שָׂטָן מִלְּפָנֵֽינוּ וּמֵאַחֲרֵֽינוּ, וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶֽיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽנוּ, וּשְׁמוֹר צֵאתֵֽנוּ וּבוֹאֵֽנוּ לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם. כִּי אֵל שׁוֹמְרֵֽנוּ וּמַצִּילֵֽנוּ אָֽתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, שׁוֹמֵר אֶת־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַד:

parts.text: בְּעָלְמָֽא דִּי בְרָֽא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִֽיךְ מַלְכוּתֵֽהּ,
אָמֵֽן: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּֽא מְבָרַֽךְ לְעָלַֽם וּלְעָלְמֵֽי עָלְמַיָּֽא.

segs.text: אֲדֹנָי, שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח, וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ:

בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵֽי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, אֱלֹהֵֽי אַבְרָהָֽם, אֱלֹהֵֽי יִצְחָֽק, וֵאלֹהֵֽי יַעֲקֹֽב, הָאֵֽל הַגָּדֽוֹל הַגִּבּֽוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָֽא, אֵל עֶלְיֽוֹן, גּוֹמֵֽל חֲסָדִֽים טוֹבִֽים, קוֹנֵֽה הַכֹּֽל, וְזוֹכֵֽר חַסְדֵּֽי אָבֽוֹת, וּמֵבִֽיא גּוֹאֵֽל לִבְנֵֽי בְנֵיהֶֽם לְמַֽעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָֽה:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

segs.text: מֶֽלֶךְ עוֹזֵֽר וּמוֹשִֽׁיעַ וּמָגֵֽן: בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, מָגֵֽן אַבְרָהָֽם:
אַתָּֽה גִּבּֽוֹר לְעוֹלָֽם אֲדֹנָֽי, מְחַיֶּֽה מֵתִֽים אַתָּֽה, רַב לְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ:

מְכַלְכֵּֽל חַיִּֽים בְּחֶֽסֶד, מְחַיֶּֽה מֵתִֽים בְּרַחֲמִֽים רַבִּֽים, סוֹמֵֽךְ נוֹפְלִֽים, וְרוֹפֵֽא חוֹלִֽים, וּמַתִּֽיר אֲסוּרִֽים, וּמְקַיֵּֽם אֱמוּנָתֽוֹ לִישֵׁנֵֽי עָפָֽר. מִי־כָמֽוֹךָ בַּֽעַל גְּבוּרֽוֹת וּמִֽי דּֽוֹמֶה לָּךְ, מֶֽלֶךְ מֵמִֽית וּמְחַיֶּֽה וּמַצְמִֽיחַ יְשׁוּעָֽה:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: מִי־כָמֽוֹךָ אָב הָרַחֲמָֽן זוֹכֵֽר יְצוּרָֽיו לְחַיִּֽים בְּרַחֲמִים:

segs.text: וְנֶאֱמָֽן אַתָּֽה לְהַחֲיוֹֽת מֵתִֽים. בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, מְחַיֶּֽה הַמֵּתִֽים:

parts.text: וּקְדוֹשִֽׁים בְּכָל־יוֹֽם יְהַלְלֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה. בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ,

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

segs.text: אַתָּֽה חוֹנֵֽן לְאָדָֽם דַּֽעַת, וּמְלַמֵּֽד לֶאֱנֽוֹשׁ בִּינָֽה.

parts.en: On Motzaei Shabbat and Yom Tov, say:

parts.text: (אַתָּה חוֹנַנְתָּֽנוּ לְמַדַּע תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ, וַתְּלַמְּדֵֽנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֵּי רְצוֹנֶֽךָ, וַתַּבְדֵּל יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בֵּין קֹֽדֶשׁ לְחוֹל, בֵּין אוֹר לְחֽשֶׁךְ, בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַמִּים, בֵּין יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לְשֵֽׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה, אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ, הָחֵל עָלֵֽינוּ הַיָּמִים הַבָּאִים לִקְרָאתֵֽנוּ לְשָׁלוֹם, חֲשׂוּכִים מִכָּל־חֵטְא, וּמְנֻקִּים מִכָּל־עָוֹן וּמְדֻבָּקִים בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ: וְ)

segs.text: חָנֵּֽנוּ מֵאִתְּךָֽ חָכְמָֽה בִּינָֽה וָדָֽעַת. בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, חוֹנֵֽן הַדָּֽעַת:
הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ אָבִינוּ לְתוֹרָתֶךָ, וְקָרְבֵנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ, וְהַחֲזִירֵנוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶיךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הָרוֹצֶה בִּתְשׁוּבָה:
סְלַח־לָנוּ אָבִינוּ, כִּי חָטָאנוּ, מְחוֹל לָנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ, כִּי פָשָׁעְנוּ, כִּי אֵל טוֹב וְסַלָּח אָֽתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, חַנּוּן, הַמַּרְבֶּה לִסְלוֹחַ:
רְאֵה נָא בְעָנְיֵנוּ וְרִיבָה רִיבֵנוּ, וּגְאָלֵנוּ מְהֵרָה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, כִּי אֵל גּוֹאֵל חָזָק אָֽתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, גּוֹאֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל:

רְפָאֵנוּ יְיָ וְנֵרָפֵא, הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה, כִּי תְהִלָּתֵנוּ אָֽתָּה, וְהַעֲלֵה אֲרוּכָה וּרְפוּאָה שְׁלֵמָה לְכָל־מַכּוֹתֵינוּ. כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ רוֹפֵא נֶאֱמָן וְרַחֲמָן אָֽתָּה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, רוֹפֵא חוֹלֵי עַמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:

parts.text: בָּרֵךְ עָלֵינוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת־הַשָּׁנָה הַזֹּאת וְאֵת כָּל־מִינֵי תְבוּאָתָהּ לְטוֹבָה וְתֵן
טַל וּמָטָר לִבְרָכָה עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה,
כִּי אֵל טוֹב וּמֵטִיב אַתָּה וּמְבָרֵךְ הַשָּׁנִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ,

segs.text: תְּקַע בְּשׁוֹפָר גָּדוֹל לְחֵרוּתֵנוּ, וְשָׂא נֵס לְקַבֵּץ גָּלֻיּוֹתֵינוּ, וְקַבְּצֵנוּ יַחַד מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפוֹת הָאָרֶץ לְאַרְצֵנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְקַבֵּץ נִדְחֵי עַמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:

parts.text: וּמְלוֹךְ עָלֵינוּ אַתָּה יְיָ לְבַדְּךָ בְּחֶסֶד וּבְרַחֲמִים,

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

segs.text: וְלַמַּלְשִׁינִים אַל תְּהִי תִקְוָה, וְכָל־הַמִּינִים וְכָל־הַזֵּדִים כְּרֶגַע יֹאבֵדוּ, וְכָל אֹיְבֵי עַמְּךָ מְהֵרָה יִכָּרֵתוּ, וּמַּלְכוּת הָרִשְׁעָה מְהֵרָה תְעַקֵּר וּתְשַׁבֵּר וּתְמַגֵּר, וְתַכְנִיעַ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, שֹׁבֵר אֹיְבִים וּמַכְנִיעַ זֵדִים:

עַל־הַצַּדִּיקִים וְעַל־הַחֲסִידִים, וְעַל־זִקְנֵי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְעַל פְּלֵיטַת בֵּית סוֹפְרֵיהֶם, וְעַל־גֵּרֵי הַצֶּדֶק וְעָלֵינוּ, יֶהֱמוּ נָא רַחֲמֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וְתֵן שָׂכָר טוֹב לְכָל־הַבּוֹטְחִים בְּשִׁמְךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, וְשִׂים חֶלְקֵנוּ עִמָּהֶם, וּלְעוֹלָם לֹא נֵבוֹשׁ כִּי בְךָ בָּטָחְנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מִשְׁעָן וּמִבְטָח לַצַּדִּיקִים:

וְלִירוּשָׁלַ͏ִם עִירְךָֽ בְּרַחֲמִֽים תָּשֽׁוּב, וְתִשְׁכּֽוֹן בְּתוֹכָֽהּ כַּאֲשֶֽׁר דִּבַּֽרְתָּ, וְכִסֵּֽא דָוִֽד עַבְדְּךָֽ מְהֵרָֽה בְּתוֹכָֽהּ תָּכִֽין, וּבְנֵֽה אוֹתָֽהּ בְּקָרֽוֹב בְּיָמֵֽינוּ בִּנְיַֽן עוֹלָֽם. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, בּוֹנֵֽה יְרוּשָׁלָ͏ִם:
אֶת־צֶֽמַח דָּוִֽד עַבְדְּךָֽ מְהֵרָֽה תַצְמִֽיחַ, וְקַרְנֽוֹ תָּרֽוּם בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ, כִּי לִישׁוּעָתְךָֽ קִּוִּֽינוּ כָּל־הַיּוֹֽם. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מַצְמִֽיחַ קֶֽרֶן יְשׁוּעָֽה:

שְׁמַע קוֹלֵֽנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, אָב הָרַחֲמָֽן רַחֵֽם עָלֵינוּ, וְקַבֵּֽל בְּרַחֲמִֽים וּבְרָצֽוֹן אֶת־תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ, כִּי אֵל שׁוֹמֵֽע תְּפִלּֽוֹת וְתַחֲנוּנִֽים אָֽתָּה, וּמִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ רֵיקָֽם אַל־תְּשִׁיבֵֽנוּ. כִּי אַתָּֽה שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלַּֽת כָּל־פֶּֽה. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, שׁוֹמֵֽעַ תְּפִלָּֽה:

רְצֵה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּעַמְּךָֽ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלִתְפִלָּתָֽם שְׁעֵה, וְהָשֵֽׁב הָעֲבוֹדָֽה לִדְבִֽיר בֵּיתֶךָ, וְאִשֵּֽׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָֽם בְּאַהֲבָֽה תְקַבֵּֽל בְּרָצֽוֹן, וּתְהִֽי לְרָצֽוֹן תָּמִֽיד עֲבוֹדַֽת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ:

parts.en: On Rosh Chodesh and Chol HaMoed, say:

parts.text: וְזִכְרוֹן כָּל־עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְֹרָאֵל לְפָנֶיךָ לִפְלֵיטָה לְטוֹבָה,
לְחֵן וּלְחֶסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים וּלְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם,

זָכְרֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בּוֹ לְטוֹבָה. וּפָקְדֵנוּ בוֹ לִבְרָכָה. וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ בוֹ לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים. וּבִדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים חוּס וְחָנֵּנוּ וְרַחֵם עָלֵינו וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ כִּי אֵלֶיךָ עֵינֵינוּ,
כִּי אֵל מֶלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָתָּה:

segs.text: וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן:

parts.text: לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵֽי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, צוּר חַיֵּינוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ, אַתָּה־הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר, נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ, עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ, וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ, וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־יוֹם עִמָּנוּ, וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־עֵת, עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֱרָיִם. הַטּוֹב, כִּי לֹּא־כָלֽוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, הַמְרַחֵֽם, כִּי לֹא־תַֽמּוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ, כִּי מֵעוֹלָֽם קִוִּֽינוּ לָךְ:

parts.en: On Chanukah and Purim, say here Al HaNissim:

parts.text: וְעַל הַנִּסִּים וְעַל הַפֻּרְקָן וְעַל הַגְּבוּרוֹת וְעַל הַתְּשׁוּעוֹת וְעַל הַנִּפְלָאוֹת שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם בִּזְּמַן הַזֶּה:
בִּימֵי מַתִּתְיָהו בֶּן יוֹחָנָן כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל,
כְּשֶׁעָמְדָה מַלְכוּת יָוָן הָרְשָׁעָה עַל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל,
עָמַדְתָּ לָהֶם בְּעֵת צָרָתָם. רַבְתָּ אֶת־רִיבָם,
וְזֵדִים בְּיַד עוֹסְקֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ. וּלְךָ עָשִׂיתָ שֵׁם גָּדוֹל וְקָדוֹשׁ בְּעוֹלָמֶךָ,
וּלְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשִׂיתָ תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וּפֻרְקָן כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה. וְאַחַר כָּךְ בָּאוּ בָנֶיךָ לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶךָ,
וּשְׁלָלָם לָבוֹז. וְאַתָּה בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים הֵפַרְתָּ אֶת עֲצָתוֹ,

segs.text: וְעַל־כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרֵךְ וְיִתְרוֹמָם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

segs.text: וְכָל־הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל לְעוֹלָם כִּי טוֹב, הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה, הָאֵל הַטּוֹב. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת:

parts.text: שִׂים שָׁלוֹם, טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה, חַיִּים חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים, עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ. בָּרְכֵנוּ אָבִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ, כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ נָתַתָּ לָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד, וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם, וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עֵת וּבְכָל־שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: וּבְסֵֽפֶר חַיִּים בְּרָכָה וְשָׁלוֹם וּפַרְנָסָה טוֹבָה יְשׁוּעָה וְנֶחָמָה וּגְזֵרוֹת טוֹבוֹת נִזָּכֵר וְנִכָּתֵב לְפָנֶֽיךָ,
בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם:

segs.text: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:

אֱלֹהַי, נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע, וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה, וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם, וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה. פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ תִּרְדּוֹף נַפְשִׁי, וְכָל־הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה, מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם: יִהְיוּ כְּמֹץ לִפְנֵי רוּחַ וּמַלְאַךְ יְיָ דּוֹחֶה. לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ, הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי: עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יְמִינֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תּוֹרָתֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ. יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:

segs.en: Bow, take three steps back as if taking leave of the Divine Presence, then bow left, right and center, while saying:
segs.text: <small>כורע ופוסע שלוש פסיעות לאחור, ואחר כך משתחווה שמאלה, ימינה ואמצע, ואומר:</small>

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל,

segs.text: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, שֶׁיִבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ, וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ:

segs.en: The chazzan says Kaddish Shalem (and when saying Vihi No'am, Half Kaddish)
segs.text: <small>הש״ץ אומר קדיש שלם (וכשאומרים ויהי נועם, חצי קדיש)</small>

parts.text: בְּעָלְמָֽא דִּי בְרָֽא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִֽיךְ מַלְכוּתֵֽהּ,
אָמֵֽן: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּֽא מְבָרַֽךְ לְעָלַֽם וּלְעָלְמֵֽי עָלְמַיָּֽא.

segs.text: למוצאי שבת
וִיהִי נֹעַם אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵינוּ עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָה עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנֵהוּ׃

יֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן׃ אֹמַר לַייָ מַחְסִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אֱלֹהַי אֶבְטַח־בּוֹ׃ כִּי הוּא יַצִּילְךָ מִפַּח יָקוּשׁ מִדֶּבֶר הַוּוֹת׃ בְּאֶבְרָתוֹ יָסֶךְ לָךְ וְתַחַת־כְּנָפָיו תֶּחְסֶה צִנָּה וְסֹחֵרָה אֲמִתּוֹ׃ לֹא־תִירָא מִפַּחַד לָיְלָה מֵחֵץ יָעוּף יוֹמָם׃ מִדֶּבֶר בָּאֹפֶל יַהֲלֹךְ מִקֶּטֶב יָשׁוּד צָהֳרָיִם׃ יִפֹּל מִצִּדְּךָ אֶלֶף וּרְבָבָה מִימִינֶךָ אֵלֶיךָ לֹא יִגָּשׁ׃ רַק בְּעֵינֶיךָ תַבִּיט וְשִׁלֻּמַת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה׃ כִּי־אַתָּה יְיָ מַחְסִי עֶלְיוֹן שַׂמְתָּ מְעוֹנֶךָ׃ לֹא־תְאֻנֶּה אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וְנֶגַע לֹא־יִקְרַב בְּאָהֳלֶךָ׃ כִּי מַלְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה־לָּךְ לִשְׁמָרְךָ בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶיךָ׃ עַל־כַּפַּיִם יִשָּׂאוּנְךָ פֶּן־תִּגֹּף בָּאֶבֶן רַגְלֶךָ׃ עַל־שַׁחַל וָפֶתֶן תִּדְרֹךְ תִּרְמֹס כְּפִיר וְתַנִּין׃ כִּי בִי חָשַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵהוּ אֲשַׂגְּבֵהוּ כִּי־יָדַע שְׁמִי׃ יִקְרָאֵנִי וְאֶעֱנֵהוּ עִמּוֹ־אָנֹכִי בְצָרָה אֲחַלְּצֵהוּ וַאֲכַבְּדֵהוּ׃ אֹרֶךְ יָמִים אַשְׂבִּיעֵהוּ וְאַרְאֵהוּ בִּישׁוּעָתִי׃

parts.text: יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל: וְקָרָא זֶה אֶל־זֶה וְאָמַר,
מְלֺא כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ: וּמְקַבְּלִין דֵּין מִן־דֵּין,
וְאָמְרִין קַדִּישׁ בִּשְׁמֵי מְרוֹמָא עִלָּאָה בֵּית שְׁכִינְתֵּהּ,
מַלְיָא כָל־אַרְעָא זִיו יְקָרֵהּ: וַתִּשָּׂאֵֽנִי רֽוּחַ,

בָּרוּךְ כְּבוֹד־יְיָ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ: וּנְטַלְתַּנִי רוּחָא וּשְׁמָעִית בַּתְרַי קַל זִֽיעַ סַגִּיא דִּמְשַׁבְּחִין וְאָמְרִין בְּרִיךְ יְקָרָא דַייָ מֵאֲתַר בֵּית שְׁכִינְתֵּהּ: יְיָ יִמְלֺךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: יְיָ מַלְכוּתֵהּ קָאֵם לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא: יְיָ אֱלֺהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ,
וְהָכֵן לְבָבָם אֵלֶֽיךָ: וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֹן וְלֺא יַשְׁחִית,
וְלֺא־יָעִיר כָּל־חֲמָתוֹ: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב־חֶֽסֶד לְכָל קֹרְאֶֽיךָ: צִדְקָתְךָ צֶֽדֶק לְעוֹלָם,
אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ מִֽימֵי קֶֽדֶם: בָּרוּךְ אֲדֹנָי,
הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ סֶֽלָה: יְיָ צְבָאוֹת עִמָּֽנוּ,
מִשְׂגָּב־לָֽנוּ אֱלֺהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶֽלָה: יְיָ צְבָאוֹת,
אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵֽחַ בָּךְ: יְיָ הוֹשִֽׁיעָה,
הַמֶּֽלֶךְ יַעֲנֵֽנוּ בְיוֹם־קָרְאֵֽנוּ: בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ שֶׁבְּרָאָֽנוּ לִכְבוֹדוֹ,
וְלֺא נֵלֵד לַבֶּהָלָה: וּבְכֵן יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְיָ אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֺהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ,
לִשְׁנֵי יְמוֹת הַמָּשִֽׁיחַ וּלְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא: לְמַֽעַן יְזַמֶּרְךָ כָבוֹד וְלֺא יִדֹּם,
יְיָ אֱלֺהַי לְעוֹלָם אוֹדֶֽךָּ: בָּרוּךְ הַגֶּֽבֶר אֲשֶׁר יִבְטַח בַּייָ,
וְהָיָה יְיָ מִבְטַחוֹ: בִּטְחוּ בַייָ עֲדֵי־עַד,
כִּי בְּיָהּ יְיָ צוּר עוֹלָמִים: וְיִבְטְחוּ בְךָ יוֹדְעֵי שְׁמֶֽךָ,
כִּי לֺא־עָזַֽבְתָּ דֹרְשֶֽׁיךָ יְיָ: יְיָ חָפֵץ לְמַֽעַן צִדְקוֹ,
בְּעָלְמָֽא דִּי בְרָֽא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִֽיךְ מַלְכוּתֵֽהּ,
אָמֵֽן: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּֽא מְבָרַֽךְ לְעָלַֽם וּלְעָלְמֵֽי עָלְמַיָּֽא.
תִּתְקַבֵּל צְלוֹתְהוֹן וּבָעוּתְהוֹן דְּכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, קֳדָם אֲבוּהוֹן דִּי בִשְׁמַיָּא וְאִמְרוּ
יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּֽא מִן־שְׁמַיָּֽא וְחַיִּֽים טוֹבִֽים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְאִמְרֽוּ

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו הוּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה שָׁלֽוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְאִמְרֽוּ

עָלֵֽינוּ לְשַׁבֵּֽחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל, לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית, שֶׁלֺּא עָשָֽׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת, וְלֺא שָׂמָֽנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה, שֶׁלֺּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵֽנוּ כָּהֶם, וְגוֹרָלֵֽנוּ כְּכָל־הֲמוֹנָם, שֶׁהֵם מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לְהֶֽבֶל וְלָרִיק:

לִפְנֵי מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ, בָּרוּךְ הוּא: שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַֽיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָֽרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים, הוּא אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ אֵין עוֹד, אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּֽנוּ, אֶֽפֶס זוּלָתוֹ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל־לְבָבֶֽךָ, כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֺהִים בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל, וְעַל־הָאָֽרֶץ מִתָּֽחַת, אֵין עוֹד:

segs.text: וְעַל־כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ, לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶֽרֶת עֻזֶּֽךָ, לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים מִן הָאָֽרֶץ וְהָאֱלִילִים כָּרוֹת יִכָּרֵתוּן, לְתַקֵּן עוֹלָם בְּמַלְכוּת שַׁדַּי: וְכָל־בְּנֵי־בָשָׂר יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁמֶֽךָ, לְהַפְנוֹת אֵלֶֽיךָ כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי אָֽרֶץ. יַכִּֽירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל־יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, כִּי־לְךָ תִכְרַע כָּל־בֶּֽרֶךְ, תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל־לָשׁוֹן: לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְיָ אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ יִכְרְעוּ וְיִפּֽוֹלוּ, וְלִכְבוֹד שִׁמְךָ יְקָר יִתֵּֽנוּ, וִיקַבְּלוּ כֻלָּם עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־עוֹל מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ, וְתִמְלוֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, כִּי הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁלְּךָ הִיא, וּלְעֽוֹלְמֵי עַד תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ: יְיָ יִמְלֺךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד. וְנֶאֱמַר: וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶֽלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ, בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:
קדיש יתום

parts.text: בְּעָלְמָֽא דִּי בְרָֽא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִֽיךְ מַלְכוּתֵֽהּ,
אָמֵֽן: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּֽא מְבָרַֽךְ לְעָלַֽם וּלְעָלְמֵֽי עָלְמַיָּֽא.
יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּֽא מִן־שְׁמַיָּֽא וְחַיִּֽים טוֹבִֽים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְאִמְרֽוּ

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו הוּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה שָׁלֽוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְאִמְרֽוּ

segs.text: אַל־תִּירָא מִפַּחַד פִּתאֹם, וּמִשֹׁאַת רְשָׁעִים כִּי תָבֹא: עֻֽצוּ עֵצָה וְתֻפָר, דַּבְּרוּ דָבָר וְלֹא יָקוּם כִּי עִמָּנוּ אֵל: וְעַד זִקְנָה אֲנִי הוּא, וְעַד שֵׂיבָה אֲנִי אֶסְבֹּל: אֲנִי עָשִֽׂיתִי וַאֲנִי אֶשָׂא וַאֲנִי אֶסְבֹּל וַאֲמַלֵּט: אַךְ צַדִּיקִים יוֹדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ יֵשְׁבוּ יְשָׁרִים אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ׃
And He, being compassionate, atones for iniquity and does not destroy; He often turns back His anger and does not stir up all His wrath. Hashem, save! May the King answer us on the day we call.

A song of ascents. Behold, bless Hashem, all servants of Hashem who stand in the house of Hashem at night. Lift up your hands toward the sanctuary and bless Hashem. May Hashem bless you from Zion, He Who made heaven and earth. By day Hashem commands His kindness, and at night His song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life. The salvation of the righteous is from Hashem, their stronghold in time of trouble. Hashem helps them and delivers them; He delivers them from the wicked and saves them, for they take refuge in Him. Hashem of Hosts is with us, the God of Jacob is our stronghold, Selah. (Three times.) Hashem of Hosts, happy is the person who trusts in You. (Three times.) Hashem, save! May the King answer us on the day we call. (Three times.)

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. Amen. In the world that He created according to His will; and may He establish His kingdom, and cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. Amen. In your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say: Amen. May His great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, uplifted and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. Blessed is He. Amen. Beyond all the blessings and songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say: Amen.
Bless Hashem, the Blessed One.
Blessed is Hashem, the Blessed One, forever and ever.

Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who by His word brings on the evenings, with wisdom opens the gates, and with understanding changes the times and alters the seasons, and arranges the stars in their watches in the sky according to His will. He creates day and night, rolls away light before darkness and darkness before light. He makes the day pass and brings on the night, and divides between day and night: Hashem of Hosts is His Name. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who brings on the evenings.

With everlasting love You have loved the House of Israel, Your people; Torah and commandments, statutes and ordinances, You have taught us. Therefore, Hashem our God, when we lie down and when we rise we will speak of Your statutes, and we will rejoice in the words of Your Torah and in Your commandments forever and ever. For they are our life and the length of our days, and on them we will meditate day and night. May Your love never depart from us (some texts read: may You never remove it from us) forever. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who loves His people Israel.
Hear, O Israel: Hashem is our God, Hashem is One.
Blessed be the name of His glorious kingdom forever and ever.

You shall love Hashem your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might. These words that I command you today shall be upon your heart. You shall teach them diligently to your children, and speak of them when you sit in your house, when you walk on the way, when you lie down and when you rise. You shall bind them as a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as ornaments between your eyes. You shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates.

And it shall be, if you listen diligently to My commandments that I command you this day, to love Hashem your God and to serve Him with all your heart and with all your soul, I will give the rain of your land in its season, the early rain and the late rain, that you may gather in your grain, your wine and your oil. And I will give grass in your field for your cattle, and you will eat and be satisfied. Beware, lest your heart be seduced and you turn away and serve other gods and bow down to them. Then the anger of Hashem will blaze against you, and He will shut up the heavens so that there will be no rain, and the ground will not yield its produce, and you will perish quickly from the good land that Hashem gives you. You shall place these words of Mine upon your heart and upon your soul, and bind them as a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as totafot between your eyes. You shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house and when you walk on the way, when you lie down and when you rise. You shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates, so that your days and the days of your children may be multiplied on the land that Hashem swore to your fathers to give them, as the days of the heavens above the earth.

Hashem spoke to Moses, saying: Speak to the children of Israel and say to them that they shall make for themselves tzitzit on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and they shall put on the tzitzit of each corner a thread of techelet. It shall be tzitzit for you, and you shall look at it and remember all the commandments of Hashem and do them, and you shall not stray after your heart and after your eyes, after which you go astray, so that you may remember and do all My commandments and be holy to your God. I am Hashem your God, Who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God; I am Hashem your God.

True and faithful is all this, and it stands firm for us, that He is Hashem our God and there is none besides Him, and we are Israel His people. He redeems us from the hand of kings, our King, and delivers us from the grasp of all tyrants. He is the God Who exacts retribution for us from our adversaries and repays all the enemies of our soul. He does great things beyond comprehension, and wonders without number. He has set our soul in life, and has not allowed our foot to slip. He leads us over the high places of our enemies, and raises our horn over all who hate us. He is the God Who performed vengeance for us against Pharaoh, and signs and wonders in the land of the children of Ham. In His wrath He struck all the firstborn of Egypt, and brought His people Israel out from among them to everlasting freedom. He led His children through the divided parts of the Sea of Reeds, and sank their pursuers and their enemies in the depths. His children saw His might; they praised and gave thanks to His Name. And they willingly accepted His sovereignty upon themselves. Moses and the children of Israel answered You with a song in great joy, and all of them said:

Who is like You among the mighty, Hashem? Who is like You, majestic in holiness, awesome in praises, working wonders? Your children saw Your sovereignty as You split the sea before Moses; “This is my God!” they answered and said: “Hashem will reign forever and ever.” And it is said: “For Hashem has redeemed Jacob and delivered him from the hand of one stronger than he.” Blessed are You, Hashem, Who redeemed Israel.

Lay us down, our Father, in peace, and raise us up, our King, to good life and to peace. Set us right with good counsel from before You, and save us speedily for Your Name’s sake. Spread over us the shelter of Your peace. Shield us, and remove from us enemy, pestilence, sword, famine, and sorrow. Remove the adversary from before us and from behind us, and conceal us in the shadow of Your wings. Guard our going out and our coming in, for good life and for peace, from now and forever. For You are the God Who guards and rescues us. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who guards His people Israel forever.

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. Amen. In the world that He created according to His will; and may He establish His kingdom, and cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. Amen. In your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say: Amen. May His great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, uplifted and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. Blessed is He. Amen. Beyond all the blessings and songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say: Amen.
Hashem, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

Blessed are You, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob; the great, mighty and awesome God, the Most High God, Who bestows good kindnesses and is Master of all, Who remembers the kindnesses of the fathers, and Who brings a redeemer to their children’s children, for His Name’s sake, with love.
Remember us for life, King Who desires life, and inscribe us in the Book of Life, for Your sake, living God.
King, Helper, Savior and Shield. Blessed are You, Hashem, Shield of Abraham.
You, Hashem, are mighty forever; You revive the dead; You are abundant in saving.

parts.text: He causes the dew to fall.
He causes the wind to blow and the rain to fall.

segs.text: He sustains the living with kindness, revives the dead with abundant mercy, supports the fallen, heals the sick, releases the bound, and keeps His faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like You, Master of mighty deeds, and who resembles You, King Who brings death and gives life and causes salvation to sprout?
Who is like You, Father of mercy, Who remembers His creatures for life in mercy.
And You are faithful to revive the dead. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who revives the dead.

parts.text: You are holy and Your Name is holy, and holy ones praise You every day, forever. Blessed are You, Hashem,

segs.text: You graciously give man knowledge and teach mortals understanding.

You have graciously given us knowledge of Your Torah, and You have taught us to perform the statutes of Your will; and You, Hashem our God, have made a distinction between the sacred and the profane, between light and darkness, between Israel and the nations, between the seventh day and the six days of work. Our Father, our King, begin for us the days that are coming toward us in peace, withheld from all sin, cleansed of all iniquity, and attached to Your awe; and
graciously grant us from You wisdom, understanding and knowledge. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who graciously gives knowledge.
Return us, our Father, to Your Torah, and bring us near, our King, to Your service, and bring us back in complete repentance before You. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who desires repentance.
Forgive us, our Father, for we have sinned; pardon us, our King, for we have transgressed; for You are a good and forgiving God. Blessed are You, Hashem, the gracious One Who abundantly forgives.
Look upon our affliction and plead our cause, and redeem us speedily for Your Name’s sake, for You are a mighty Redeemer. Blessed are You, Hashem, Redeemer of Israel.

Heal us, Hashem, and we will be healed; save us, and we will be saved, for You are our praise. Bring complete healing and cure for all our wounds, for You are a God, King, a faithful and merciful Healer. Blessed are You, Hashem, Healer of the sick of His people Israel.

parts.text: Bless this year for us, Hashem our God, and all the kinds of its produce for good, and give
dew and rain for a blessing upon the face of the earth
and satisfy us from Your goodness, and bless our year like the good years, for blessing. For You are a good God Who does good, and You bless the years. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who blesses the years.

segs.text: Sound the great shofar for our freedom, raise a banner to gather our exiles, and gather us together from the four corners of the earth into our land. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who gathers the dispersed of His people Israel.

parts.text: Restore our judges as at first, and our counselors as at the beginning; remove from us sorrow and sighing; and reign over us, You alone, Hashem, with kindness and mercy, with righteousness and justice. Blessed are You, Hashem,
the King Who loves righteousness and justice.

segs.text: May the slanderers have no hope, and may all the heretics and all the arrogant perish in an instant; may all the enemies of Your people be swiftly cut down; may You swiftly uproot, shatter, crush and humble the evil kingdom, speedily in our days. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who breaks enemies and humbles the arrogant.

Upon the righteous, upon the pious, upon the elders of Your people the House of Israel, upon the remnant of their scholars, upon the righteous converts, and upon us, may Your mercies be stirred, Hashem our God; and grant a good reward to all who trust in Your Name in truth, and place our portion with them, and may we never be ashamed, for in You we trust. Blessed are You, Hashem, Support and Trust of the righteous.

And to Jerusalem Your city return in mercy, and dwell within it as You have spoken; and speedily establish within it the throne of David Your servant, and build it soon in our days as an everlasting structure. Blessed are You, Hashem, Builder of Jerusalem.

Speedily cause the offspring of David Your servant to flourish, and raise his horn through Your salvation, for we hope for Your salvation all day long. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who causes the horn of salvation to flourish.

Hear our voice, Hashem our God; merciful Father, have compassion on us, and accept our prayer with mercy and favor, for You are a God Who hears prayers and supplications; and do not turn us away from before You empty-handed, our King. For You hear the prayer of every mouth. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who hears prayer.

Be pleased, Hashem our God, with Your people Israel and their prayer; restore the service to the inner sanctuary of Your House; accept with love and favor the fire-offerings of Israel and their prayer; and may the service of Your people Israel always be pleasing to You.

parts.text: Our God and God of our fathers, may there ascend, come, reach, be seen, be favored, be heard, be recalled and be remembered: our remembrance and our reckoning, the remembrance of our fathers, the remembrance of Mashiach son of David Your servant, the remembrance of Jerusalem Your holy city, and the remembrance of all Your people the House of Israel before You, for deliverance, for good, for grace, kindness and mercy, for good life and for peace, on this day of

Remember us, Hashem our God, on it for good; reckon us on it for blessing; and save us on it for good life. With a word of salvation and mercy, spare us and be gracious to us, and have mercy on us and save us, for our eyes are turned to You, for You are a gracious and merciful God and King.

segs.text: And may our eyes behold Your return to Zion in mercy. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who restores His Presence to Zion.

We gratefully thank You, for You are Hashem our God and God of our fathers forever and ever; Rock of our lives, Shield of our salvation, You are the same from generation to generation. We will thank You and recount Your praise, for our lives, which are committed into Your hand, and for our souls, which are entrusted to You, and for Your miracles that are with us every day, and for Your wonders and Your favors that occur at every time, evening, morning and noon. You are the Good One, for Your mercies never end; You are the Merciful One, for Your kindnesses never cease; we have always put our hope in You.
[We thank You also] for the miracles, for the redemption, for the mighty deeds, for the saving acts and for the wonders that You performed for our ancestors in those days, at this time.

In the days of Mattityahu, son of Yochanan the High Priest, the Hasmonean, and his sons, when the wicked Greek kingdom rose up against Your people Israel to make them forget Your Torah and to turn them away from the statutes of Your will, You, in Your abundant mercy, stood by them in their time of distress. You waged their battle, You judged their claim, You avenged their wrong. You delivered the strong into the hands of the weak, the many into the hands of the few, the impure into the hands of the pure, the wicked into the hands of the righteous, and the willful sinners into the hands of those who occupy themselves with Your Torah. You made a great and holy name for Yourself in Your world, and for Your people Israel You performed a great salvation and redemption to this very day. Afterward Your children came to the sanctuary of Your House, cleansed Your Temple, purified Your Sanctuary, kindled lights in Your holy courtyards, and established these eight days of Chanukah to give thanks and praise to Your great name.

In the days of Mordechai and Esther, in Shushan the capital, when the wicked Haman rose up against them and sought to destroy, slay and exterminate all the Jews, young and old, children and women, in one day, on the thirteenth of the twelfth month, which is the month of Adar, and to plunder their possessions. But You, in Your abundant mercy, nullified his counsel and frustrated his plan, and returned his reward upon his own head, and they hanged him and his sons on the gallows.
And for all of them, may Your Name, our King, be continually blessed, exalted and elevated forever and ever.
And inscribe for a good life all the children of Your covenant.

And all the living will thank You forever, and will praise Your great Name forever, for it is good; the God of our salvation and our help forever, the good God. Blessed are You, Hashem, Your Name is the Good, and to You it is fitting to give thanks.

parts.text: Grant peace, goodness and blessing, life, grace, kindness and mercy upon us and upon all Israel Your people. Bless us, our Father, all of us as one, with the light of Your countenance, for with the light of Your countenance You gave us, Hashem our God, the Torah of life and the love of kindness, righteousness, blessing, mercy, life and peace. May it be good in Your eyes to bless Your people Israel at every time and at every hour with Your peace.

In the Book of Life, blessing, peace and good livelihood, salvation, consolation and good decrees, may we be remembered and inscribed before You, we and all Your people the House of Israel, for a good life and for peace.
Blessed are You, Hashem, Who blesses His people Israel with peace.

segs.text: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Hashem, my Rock and my Redeemer.

My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceit; to those who curse me, let my soul be silent, and let my soul be like dust to all. Open my heart to Your Torah, and let my soul pursue Your commandments. As for all who plan evil against me, speedily annul their counsel and frustrate their plans. Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of Hashem driving them on. So that Your beloved ones may be rescued, save with Your right hand and answer me. Act for the sake of Your Name; act for the sake of Your right hand; act for the sake of Your Torah; act for the sake of Your holiness. May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Hashem, my Rock and my Redeemer.

parts.text: in His heights, may He make peace for us and for all Israel; and say: Amen.

segs.text: May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that the Holy Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant us our portion in Your Torah.

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. Amen. In the world that He created according to His will; and may He establish His kingdom, and cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. Amen. In your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say: Amen. May His great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, uplifted and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. Blessed is He. Amen. Beyond all the blessings and songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say: Amen.
May the pleasantness of Hashem our God be upon us; establish for us the work of our hands; yes, the work of our hands, establish it.

He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High shall abide in the shadow of the Almighty. I say of Hashem, “My refuge and my fortress, my God in whom I trust.” For He will save you from the snare of the hunter, from the destructive plague. He will cover you with His pinions, and under His wings you will find refuge; His truth is a shield and armor. You shall not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day, nor the plague that stalks in darkness, nor the destruction that ravages at noon. A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, but it shall not come near you. Only with your eyes will you look, and see the retribution of the wicked. Because you said, “You, Hashem, are my refuge,” you have made the Most High your dwelling. No harm shall befall you, nor shall any plague come near your tent. For He will command His angels concerning you, to guard you in all your ways. They shall carry you on their hands, lest you strike your foot against a stone. You shall tread upon the lion and the cobra; you shall trample the young lion and the serpent. “Because he has set his love upon Me, I will deliver him; I will set him on high, because he knows My Name. He will call upon Me and I will answer him; I am with him in distress; I will rescue him and honor him. With long life I will satisfy him, and show him My salvation.”

And You are holy, enthroned upon the praises of Israel. And one called to the other and said: “Holy, holy, holy is Hashem of Hosts; the whole earth is full of His glory.” And they receive from one another and say: Holy in the highest heavens, the abode of His Presence; holy upon the earth, the work of His might; holy forever and to all eternity is Hashem of Hosts; the whole earth is filled with the radiance of His glory. Then a spirit lifted me, and I heard behind me the sound of a great rushing: “Blessed be the glory of Hashem from His place.” And a spirit lifted me, and I heard behind me the sound of a great commotion of those who were praising and saying: “Blessed be the glory of Hashem from the place of the abode of His Presence.” Hashem will reign forever and ever. Hashem’s kingdom is established forever and to all eternity. Hashem, God of Abraham, Isaac and Israel, our fathers, keep this forever as the inclination of the thoughts of the heart of Your people, and direct their hearts to You. And He, being compassionate, will atone for iniquity and not destroy; He often turns back His anger and does not stir up all His wrath. For You, Hashem, are good and forgiving, and abundant in kindness to all who call upon You. Your righteousness is eternal righteousness, and Your Torah is truth. Grant truth to Jacob and kindness to Abraham, as You swore to our fathers from days of old. Blessed is Hashem, Who day by day bears our burden; the God of our salvation, Selah. Hashem of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our stronghold, Selah. Hashem of Hosts, happy is the person who trusts in You. Hashem, save! May the King answer us on the day we call. Blessed is He, our God, Who created us for His glory, and separated us from those who go astray, and gave us the Torah of truth, and planted eternal life within us. May He open our hearts to His Torah, and place in our hearts love and awe of Him, to do His will and serve Him with a whole heart, so that we will not labor in vain nor bear children for terror. And so may it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that we keep Your statutes in this world, and merit to live, see and inherit goodness and blessing in the days of the Messiah and in the life of the World to Come. So that my soul may sing to You and not be silent; Hashem my God, I will thank You forever. Blessed is the man who trusts in Hashem, and Hashem will be his trust. Trust in Hashem forever, for in Yah, Hashem, is the Rock of the worlds. Those who know Your name will trust in You, for You, Hashem, have not forsaken those who seek You. Hashem desired, for the sake of His righteousness, to make the Torah great and glorious.

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. Amen. In the world that He created according to His will; and may He establish His kingdom, and cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. Amen. In your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say: Amen. May His great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, uplifted and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. Blessed is He. Amen. Beyond all the blessings and songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say: Amen.
May the prayers and supplications of all Israel be accepted before their Father in heaven; and say: Amen.
May there be abundant peace from heaven, and good life, for us and for all Israel; and say: Amen.

parts.text: in His heights, may He make peace for us and for all Israel; and say: Amen.

segs.text: It is our duty to praise the Master of all, to ascribe greatness to the Creator of the beginning, who has not made us like the nations of the lands, nor placed us like the families of the earth; who has not set our portion as theirs, nor our lot as all their multitude, for they bow down to vanity and emptiness. But we bend the knee, bow down and give thanks before the King, King of kings, the Holy One, blessed is He, who stretches out the heavens and founds the earth, whose seat of glory is in the heavens above and the abode of His mighty Presence is in the loftiest heights. He is our God; there is no other. Truly He is our King; there is nothing besides Him, as it is written in His Torah: “Know this day and take to heart that Hashem is God in the heavens above and on the earth below; there is no other.”

Therefore we hope to You, Hashem our God, soon to see the glory of Your might, to remove abominations from the earth and to have idols utterly cut off, to perfect the world under the kingdom of the Almighty. All humankind will call on Your name, to turn to You all the wicked of the earth. All the inhabitants of the world will recognize and know that to You every knee must bow and every tongue swear. Before You, Hashem our God, they will kneel and fall, and to Your glorious name give honor; and all will accept the yoke of Your kingdom, and You will reign over them soon and forever. For the kingdom is Yours, and to all eternity You will reign in glory, as it is written in Your Torah: “Hashem will reign forever and ever.” And it is said: “Hashem will be King over all the earth; on that day Hashem will be One and His name One.”

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. Amen. In the world that He created according to His will; and may He establish His kingdom, and cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. Amen. In your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say: Amen. May His great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, uplifted and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. Blessed is He. Amen. Beyond all the blessings and songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say: Amen.
May there be abundant peace from heaven, and good life, for us and for all Israel; and say: Amen.

parts.text: in His heights, may He make peace for us and for all Israel; and say: Amen.

segs.text: Do not fear sudden terror, nor the destruction of the wicked when it comes. Devise a plan and it will be foiled; speak a word and it will not stand, for God is with us. Even to old age I am the same, and even to gray hairs I will carry you; I have made you and I will bear you, and I will carry and rescue. Surely the righteous will thank Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.

segs.en: On the second night of Pesach, one begins counting the Omer immediately after Maariv. Some say that one who is initiated in the secrets of the Torah should count after completing the entire Seder outside Israel. One who blesses and counts immediately after prayer is early for the blessing. [Gloss from the Siddur of the Admor, Baal HaTzemach Tzedek: According to the law, it is forbidden to eat until one counts, and moreover, throughout the length of the Seder, it is likely one will forget to count or count after midnight]: If one forgot and did not count at night, one counts during the day without a blessing, as is known: And the time of dawn from the 18th of Iyar and onward in these northern countries is at midnight, therefore one should not count after midnight except without a blessing, and this time of dawn continues thus until the 17th of Tammuz inclusive, and therefore once midnight of the 17th of Tammuz is reached, it is forbidden to eat.
segs.text: <small>בליל שני של פסח מתחילין לספור ספירת העומר תיכף אחר תפלת ערבית. אך יש מי שאומר שהבא בסוד ה׳ יש לספור אחר שגמר כל הסדר בחוץ לארץ והמקדים לברך ולספור מיד אחר התפלה מוקדם לברכה [הגה״ה מסדור אדמו״ר בעל הצמח צדק: דלפי הדין אסור לאכול עד שיספור ומה גם דבכל אורך הסדר קרוב הדבר שישכח מלספור או שיספור אחר חצות]: ואם שכח ולא ספר בלילה סופר ביום בלא ברכה כנודע: וזמן התחלת עמוד השחר מח״י אייר ואילך במדינות אלו הצפוניות הוא בחצות הלילה לכך אין לספור אחר חצות אלא בלא ברכה וזמן זה של עמוד השחר נמשך כך עד י״ז בתמוז ועד בכלל ולכן משהגיע חצות ליל י״ז תמוז אסור לאכול:</small>

לַמְנַצֵּֽחַ בִּנְגִינוֹת מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר: אֱלֹהִים יְחָנֵּֽנוּ וִיבָרְכֵֽנוּ יָאֵר פָּנָיו אִתָּֽנוּ סֶֽלָה: לָדַֽעַת בָּאָֽרֶץ דַּרְכֶּֽךָ בְּכָל־גּוֹיִם יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ: יוֹדֽוּךָ עַמִּים אֱלֹהִים יוֹדֽוּךָ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם: יִשְׂמְחוּ וִירַנְּנוּ לְאֻמִּים כִּי־תִשְׁפּוֹט עַמִּים מִישׁוֹר וּלְאֻמִּים בָּאָֽרֶץ תַּנְחֵם סֶֽלָה: יוֹדֽוּךָ עַמִּים אֱלֹהִים יוֹדֽוּךָ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם: אֶֽרֶץ נָתְנָה יְבוּלָהּ יְבָרְכֵֽנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ: יְבָרְכֵֽנוּ אֱלֹהִים וְיִירְאוּ אוֹתוֹ כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ:
